00b146e96c08.en: Harry’s body and soul shivered in disgust at the thought of slurping an eyeball on top of coagulated jelly hors d’oeuvres with a full stomach. The awful taste of coagulated bloody salty mixed with vinegar taste of the nari gel still felt like he had just slurped it down last night—except that happened days ago instead.
00b146e96c08.t: Tubuh dan jiwa Harry bergidik jijik membayangkan menyeruput bola mata di atas hors d’oeuvres jeli kental dengan perut penuh. Rasa mengerikan darah kental yang asin bercampur rasa cuka dari nari gel itu masih terasa seolah ia baru saja menyeruputnya semalam—padahal itu terjadi berhari-hari yang lalu.

02601e73d65c.en: Letting out a dissonant hum, Hiromi also looked at the board. “I haven’t heard of that, but yeah, I prefer targeting the yellow ones, as those are worth more if you snipe all territories.”
02601e73d65c.t: Bergumam sumbang, Hiromi juga memandang papan itu. “Aku belum pernah dengar itu, tapi iya, aku lebih suka membidik yang kuning, karena nilainya lebih tinggi kalau kau menembak semua wilayah.”

035fdc671e1b.en: Harry took another sip of his strong drink, vividly picturing The Dead Wozen tavern Hiromi was describing, including the other adventurers with him.
035fdc671e1b.t: Harry menyesap lagi minumannya yang keras, membayangkan dengan jelas kedai minum The Dead Wozen yang sedang diceritakan Hiromi, termasuk para petualang lain yang bersamanya.

053070761f65.en: “SEE? It’s all about mindset! You know what, Harry? You’re cool! So why not play a bit of territory snipping to celebrate?” Hiromi pointed to the nearby odd-looking dartboard. It kinda looked like a bird’s-eye view of a baseball field—that is, if you rotated the field to make a complete circle. There were multiple zones with different colors each.
053070761f65.t: “LIHAT? Semuanya soal pola pikir! Tahu tidak, Harry? Kau keren! Jadi bagaimana kalau kita main territory snipping sedikit untuk merayakannya?” Hiromi menunjuk papan dart yang tampak aneh di dekat situ. Papan itu agak tampak seperti lapangan bisbol dari atas—itu pun kalau kamu memutar lapangannya sampai membentuk lingkaran penuh. Ada banyak zona dengan warna berbeda-beda.

097fa426482a.en: “C’mon, Kaiana! I was just saying—” Hiromi took a gulp of his beer. The glass was twice as big as hers—so big it had to look bigger than her head. “We got it done! That’s what matters!”
097fa426482a.t: “Ayolah, Kaiana! Aku cuma bilang—” Hiromi menenggak birnya. Gelasnya dua kali lebih besar daripada gelas Kaiana—begitu besar sampai pasti tampak lebih besar dari kepalanya. “Kita berhasil menyelesaikannya! Itu yang penting!”

0cd1a9157fd1.en: Is that how you do it? Harry couldn’t stop gazing at the pure muddling muscle action. He looked at his own arms for comparison, and they were downright feminine compared to Hiromi’s.
0cd1a9157fd1.t: Begitu ya caranya? Harry tidak bisa berhenti memandangi aksi otot menumbuk murni itu. Ia memandang lengannya sendiri sebagai perbandingan, dan lengannya benar-benar feminin dibanding lengan Hiromi.

0ed9791429e0.en: Shivering from the touch of her cold hands, Harry cracked his neck by just moving it slightly. It was tender, but it seemed to be working fine. “I think so.” Embracing the left side of his neck, a flashback of Maiara’s leg rushing towards his neck sprung on him. “So—what happened?” Harry looked around the blurry familiar room. Everything seemed to look the same when he went to sleep. The drawing of the old Itagiba-looking guy fishing in the clouds and the desk where he signed the contract were still there, but he couldn’t see the bloody mess he had made—even after squinting his eyes. The fost stone lamp was still on the nightstand, but this time it was dead, revealing a whitish pearlescent-like stone inside the glass; removing the sheets covering his lower body, he noticed he was wearing nothing but a blue-with-white-stars boxers. I don’t remember wearing this—AH?! Something else, or rather the lack of something else, called to his attention—his gut was gone. “Wait! When did I lose all of this weight?”
0ed9791429e0.t: Menggigil karena sentuhan tangannya yang dingin, Harry membuat lehernya berbunyi hanya dengan menggerakkannya sedikit. Lehernya nyeri, tetapi tampaknya berfungsi dengan baik. “Kurasa begitu.” Memegangi sisi kiri lehernya, kilas balik kaki Maiara yang melesat ke arah lehernya menerjangnya. “Jadi—apa yang terjadi?” Harry memandang sekeliling ruangan buram yang familier itu. Segalanya tampak sama seperti saat ia tidur. Gambar pria tua mirip Itagiba yang sedang memancing di awan dan meja tempat ia menandatangani kontrak masih ada di sana, tetapi ia tidak bisa melihat kekacauan berdarah yang ia buat—bahkan setelah menyipitkan matanya. Lampu fost stone masih ada di meja samping ranjang, tetapi kali ini padam, memperlihatkan batu keputihan seperti mutiara di dalam kaca; menyingkap seprai yang menutupi tubuh bagian bawahnya, ia menyadari ia hanya memakai boxer biru berbintang putih. Aku tidak ingat memakai ini—AH?! Sesuatu yang lain, atau lebih tepatnya ketiadaan sesuatu yang lain, menarik perhatiannya—perutnya sudah hilang. “Tunggu! Kapan berat badanku turun sebanyak ini?”

11c9b280e6d5.en: Itanema’s eyes were drawn to the drink spilling on the floor, then the mess on the bar table. She glanced back at Hiromi with her usual neutral expression—even though she would likely be cleaning it. “There are no tabs here.”
11c9b280e6d5.t: Mata Itanema tertuju pada minuman yang tumpah ke lantai, lalu kekacauan di meja bar. Ia kembali melirik Hiromi dengan raut netralnya yang biasa—walaupun mungkin dialah yang akan membersihkannya. “Di sini tidak ada bon.”

17d7d745d70b.en: Harry’s face reddened as he imagined the situation, feeling a certain defenseless vibe rising as he was dead or passed out—or whatever state he was in. “Eh—I think I’m feeling better now. Thank you—for taking care of me!” His eyes got the courage to look at Aurora’s caramel eyes, still showing the same genuine caring as before.
17d7d745d70b.t: Wajah Harry memerah saat ia membayangkan situasi itu, merasakan semacam rasa tak berdaya yang muncul saat ia mati atau pingsan—atau apa pun keadaannya saat itu. “Eh—kurasa aku sudah merasa lebih baik sekarang. Terima kasih—sudah merawatku!” Matanya memberanikan diri memandang mata karamel Aurora, yang masih menunjukkan kepedulian tulus yang sama seperti sebelumnya.

18a52df26c2a.en: Hiromi’s threatening expression began waning as he placed the empty soap container back on the shelf. His silence and severe facade came crumbling down as he swung his head in an apparent denial that turned into acceptance. “I’m too drunk for this. You got me there. Fine. I will just give it to you then.” Hiromi turned back and walked closer to Arukia, digging his hand up into his short kilt-like clothing, getting close to his crotch.
18a52df26c2a.t: Raut mengancam Hiromi mulai memudar saat ia menaruh kembali wadah sabun yang kosong di rak. Diamnya dan fasad garangnya runtuh saat ia menggeleng dalam penyangkalan yang tampak jelas yang berubah menjadi penerimaan. “Aku terlalu mabuk untuk ini. Kau menang. Baiklah. Kuberikan saja padamu.” Hiromi berbalik dan berjalan mendekati Arukia, merogoh ke dalam pakaiannya yang pendek mirip rok kilt, mendekati selangkangannya.

1a8ce30d006b.en: “My man—did you eat gyut early on, or is that pieces of your stomach?” Hiromi laughed as he pulled the handle above the toilet, letting an angry gush of water wash it away.
1a8ce30d006b.t: “Bro—kau makan gyut tadi, atau itu potongan-potongan perutmu?” Hiromi tertawa sambil menarik tuas di atas kloset, membiarkan semburan air yang marah menyapunya.

1d697b8c39c8.en: Harry let out a chuckle. “Can I help?”

1d89944f90f5.en: Blinking, Harry stood up slowly as his brain got caught up with the complex rules—at least for his current state. “—Yea? So I play next?”
1d89944f90f5.t: Berkedip-kedip, Harry perlahan berdiri sementara otaknya mencerna aturan yang rumit itu—setidaknya rumit untuk keadaannya saat ini. “—Iya? Jadi aku main berikutnya?”

2184458b850f.en: “Yea!” Harry’s fruity voice sounded like a true adventurer’s. He pounded the rest of his drink, then slapped it back on the messy bar table with a nice clack as he scrubbed his mouth on his forearm, blurting out in a drunken slur, “You’re coolio too!”
2184458b850f.t: “Ayo!” Suara Harry yang ceria terdengar seperti suara petualang sejati. Ia menenggak habis sisa minumannya, lalu membanting gelasnya kembali ke meja bar yang berantakan dengan bunyi denting yang enak sambil menyeka mulutnya dengan lengan bawahnya, menyembur dengan cadel mabuk, “Kau juga keren abis!”

22e134e2f537.en: “Yeah, she’s always trying to prove that she’s better than Yacamim—at least she’s good at Homeegg.” A more soothed, but still just as deep, voice came from the Darfaries male as he kept on holding the strange pose. “Aiight. Repeat what I’m doing.”
22e134e2f537.t: “Iya, dia selalu berusaha membuktikan bahwa dia lebih baik dari Yacamim—setidaknya dia jago Homeegg.” Suara yang lebih tenang, tetapi tetap sama beratnya, keluar dari pria Darfaries itu sambil terus menahan pose aneh itu. “Oke. Ulangi apa yang kulakukan.”

232593596bab.en: “Yes?” The grandmotherly tone of the maid was still there, but her eyes seemed rather puzzled as she brought clothes to Harry. “You know what, hon? I saw the fight too, and you had it rough.” Going back to the same crochet bag, she dug around and pulled out a rectangular thatch box and slid it open, revealing a yellowish-with-red-chunks cake the width and girth of a finger inside. “Here’s a consolation prize from me, so keep this just between us, okay?”
232593596bab.t: “Iya?” Nada nenek-nenek pelayan itu masih ada, tetapi matanya tampak agak bingung saat ia membawakan pakaian untuk Harry. “Tahu tidak, sayang? Aku juga menonton pertarungannya, dan kamu benar-benar babak belur.” Kembali ke tas rajutan yang sama, ia merogoh-rogoh dan mengeluarkan sebuah kotak jerami persegi panjang lalu menggesernya terbuka, memperlihatkan kue kekuningan dengan potongan-potongan merah di dalamnya, selebar dan setebal jari. “Ini hadiah hiburan dariku, jadi ini rahasia kita berdua saja, oke?”

233c2710ab6b.en: The hinge of the blue atrium door creaked softly, breaking through the laughter. Next, a monotonous female voice said, “Hiromi, I see you’re teaching Harry well, but Eiri is waiting on him.”
233c2710ab6b.t: Engsel pintu atrium yang biru berderit pelan, memecah tawa. Berikutnya, suara wanita yang monoton berkata, “Hiromi, kulihat kau mengajari Harry dengan baik, tapi Eiri sedang menunggunya.”

2672240e815f.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 5: Harry and the mohawked giant, seen from behind, crouch to look at something on the floor.
2672240e815f.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 5: Harry dan raksasa bermohawk, dilihat dari belakang, berjongkok memandangi sesuatu di lantai.

27db0a797203.en: Takeo was sitting silently with a ponderous face. He didn’t seem to take the bait.
27db0a797203.t: Takeo duduk diam dengan wajah termenung. Ia tampaknya tidak termakan pancingan itu.

2962d1c5fb35.en: Harry presented himself to Eiri in her office with a sloppily clean face. His smile shone brightly; water drops ran from his wet hair, down his reddened culpable face, and dripped onto his shirt.
2962d1c5fb35.t: Harry menghadap Eiri di kantornya dengan wajah yang dibersihkan asal-asalan. Senyumnya bersinar cerah; tetesan air mengalir dari rambutnya yang basah, turun ke wajahnya yang memerah karena merasa bersalah, dan menetes ke kemejanya.

2e786fd39272.en: Eiri let go of her writing feather and stood up slowly. She patted her skirt as she spoke truthfully, “Yeah—you clearly have something you want to tell, so get it off your chest.” She came closer to Harry but then looked to be taken aback as her nose was attacked by something. “WOW—what were you doing? Did you drink lolish-floaters or what? Your BO is pretty bad too! *Hmmm—*why do you smell like a Darfaries armpit? Didn’t Aurora bathe you yesterday?”
2e786fd39272.t: Eiri melepaskan pena tulisnya dan berdiri perlahan. Ia menepuk-nepuk roknya sambil berbicara dengan jujur, “Iya—kamu jelas punya sesuatu yang ingin kamu katakan, jadi ungkapkan saja.” Ia mendekati Harry tetapi lalu tampak tersentak saat hidungnya diserang sesuatu. “WOW—kamu habis ngapain? Kamu minum lolish-floater atau apa? Bau badanmu juga parah sekali! *Hmmm—*kenapa baumu seperti ketiak Darfaries? Bukannya Aurora sudah memandikanmu kemarin?”

2ff9e97c552c.en: Harry could feel this odd ritualistic bonding happening with him, but he couldn’t break away. Even his respiration froze for a few seconds. He sealed his lips tighly, worried about a possible sloppy kiss.
2ff9e97c552c.t: Harry bisa merasakan ikatan ritual yang aneh ini terjadi padanya, tetapi ia tidak bisa melepaskan diri. Bahkan napasnya membeku selama beberapa detik. Ia mengatupkan bibirnya rapat-rapat, khawatir akan kemungkinan ciuman basah yang berantakan.

32671dd3f9a4.en: “Here, hon, spit on it.” The grandmotherly maid rushed back into the bedroom with a pot.
32671dd3f9a4.t: “Ini, sayang, ludahkan ke sini.” Pelayan bak nenek itu bergegas kembali ke kamar tidur dengan sebuah pot.

337a8b631018.en: “OH?” A gasp came out of Harry. Feeling his tension washing away, he blurted out, “So—Maiara is always like that?”
337a8b631018.t: “OH?” Harry tersentak. Merasakan ketegangannya luruh, ia menyembur, “Jadi—Maiara memang selalu begitu?”

34c6ff2e46c5.en: “For real, though, this is your opportunity to shine as Sanbi-eye! Go out and have fun! A friend said that PTSD is basically the past trying to screw over your future, so try to focus on the future instead!”
34c6ff2e46c5.t: “Tapi serius, ini kesempatanmu untuk bersinar sebagai Sanbi-eye! Pergilah keluar dan bersenang-senanglah! Seorang teman bilang PTSD pada dasarnya adalah masa lalu yang berusaha mengacaukan masa depanmu, jadi cobalah berfokus pada masa depan saja!”

35d50b4d714c.t: Tidak ada jawaban yang terlintas di benaknya.

362e3702a983.en: Harry touched his beating heart. “So—you’re saying—I actually died?”
362e3702a983.t: Harry menyentuh jantungnya yang berdetak. “Jadi—maksudmu—aku benar-benar mati?”

38c8b46564b1.en: Hiromi, coming back to himself, stood up as food juices, beer, mead, and blood dripped onto the floor. With a straight face, quite literally since his nose flattened, he slowly raised his hand to check his green and red mohawk. Not only was it soaked in all kinds of substances but he felt that part of it also got chopped off. His uneven breath, open wordless mouth, and wide eyes glanced at a sharp weapon on the table. Right by it, he saw the missing piece of his mohawk resting peacefully on the table. If he had an aura that instant, it would have turned bright red and blown up the bar into smithereens, killing everyone around. He began screaming with such horrendous guttural violence that his vocal cords were about to snap. Without hesitation, his bloodshot eyes aimed at the perpetrator, Yacamim. He ran towards Yacamim with a punch, ready to explode her brains out.
38c8b46564b1.t: Hiromi, sadar kembali, berdiri sementara sari makanan, bir, mead, dan darah menetes ke lantai. Dengan wajah datar, secara harfiah karena hidungnya remuk rata, ia perlahan mengangkat tangannya untuk memeriksa mohawk hijau dan merahnya. Bukan hanya basah kuyup oleh segala macam zat, tetapi ia merasa sebagian mohawknya juga terpotong. Napasnya yang tidak teratur, mulutnya yang terbuka tanpa kata, dan matanya yang membelalak melirik sebuah senjata tajam di meja. Tepat di sampingnya, ia melihat potongan mohawknya yang hilang tergeletak dengan damai di atas meja. Kalau ia punya aura saat itu, aura itu pasti sudah berubah merah menyala dan meledakkan bar itu berkeping-keping, membunuh semua orang di sekitarnya. Ia mulai berteriak dengan kekerasan parau yang begitu mengerikan sampai pita suaranya hampir putus. Tanpa ragu, matanya yang merah membidik si pelaku, Yacamim. Ia berlari ke arah Yacamim dengan tinju, siap meledakkan otaknya.

38f46f702696.en: With a firm nod, Harry’s mind focused solely on the what-if story—so much so that what just happened with Itanema might have been forgotten already. He took another sip of his nearly finished drink.
38f46f702696.t: Dengan anggukan mantap, pikiran Harry terpusat sepenuhnya pada cerita bagaimana-jika itu—sampai-sampai apa yang baru saja terjadi dengan Itanema mungkin sudah terlupakan. Ia menyesap lagi minumannya yang hampir habis.

38ffb8762147.en: Harry nodded, holding the single amethyst tightly in his hand.
38ffb8762147.t: Harry mengangguk, menggenggam erat amethyst tunggal itu di tangannya.

3cbea8e1f4b1.en: Looking at Hiromi, then back at Itanema, Harry flashed a big smile. “Yeah!” A fuzzy, warm feeling was dwelling inside him—or it was the alcohol filling up his belly.
3cbea8e1f4b1.t: Memandang Hiromi, lalu kembali ke Itanema, Harry menyunggingkan senyum lebar. “Iya!” Perasaan hangat dan menyenangkan bersemayam di dalam dirinya—atau itu alkohol yang memenuhi perutnya.

3df59b2fce4b.en: “Can you also help me with my eyesight again too?” Harry carefully stepped down the stairs, aggressively squinting his bad eyes to see a little better.
3df59b2fce4b.t: “Bisa kamu bantu soal penglihatanku lagi juga?” Harry dengan hati-hati menuruni tangga, menyipitkan matanya yang buruk kuat-kuat agar bisa melihat sedikit lebih jelas.

3e104b7a3bc0.en: Sora! Oh no! What if it was her? Harry tried to sit up again, but only his hands complied with the request—until they came crashing down against the comfort of the bed sheets as they grew limp.
3e104b7a3bc0.t: Sora! Oh tidak! Bagaimana kalau itu dia? Harry mencoba duduk lagi, tetapi hanya tangannya yang menuruti permintaan itu—sampai tangannya jatuh menghantam empuknya seprai karena menjadi lemas.

3f057585e54b.en: “Good try! Good try! C’mon! Try again!” Hiromi grabbed a dart from Harry’s hand and threw it towards the same green, but it landed far above it in a purple zone. “Aw, my chitin ass! Anyways, the goal is to land on the same color region to score a point. If you land on a region with someone else’s dart, you two cancel each other out. Ehh—right? Right—right. The smaller the region, the more it’s worth when sniping it. That makes sense?”
3f057585e54b.t: “Usaha bagus! Usaha bagus! Ayo! Coba lagi!” Hiromi mengambil satu dart dari tangan Harry dan melemparnya ke arah hijau yang sama, tetapi dart itu mendarat jauh di atasnya di zona ungu. “Aw, pantat kitinku! Omong-omong, tujuannya adalah mendarat di wilayah warna yang sama untuk mencetak poin. Kalau kau mendarat di wilayah yang sudah ada dart orang lain, kalian berdua saling membatalkan. Ehh—kan? Iya—iya. Semakin kecil wilayahnya, semakin tinggi nilainya kalau berhasil ditembak. Masuk akal?”

3fefbc621653.en: Takeo politely declined with a slow shake of the head, standing up as he stated monotonously, “We finished the quest. We celebrated. We all spoke our minds. Now we say our goodbyes.”
3fefbc621653.t: Takeo menolak dengan sopan dengan gelengan pelan, berdiri sambil berkata dengan monoton, “Kita sudah menyelesaikan misi. Kita sudah merayakan. Kita semua sudah mengutarakan pikiran. Sekarang kita berpamitan.”

408420fe9aa7.en: Harry couldn’t help but stare at the badass-looking red and green mohawk. The flashy silvery ear piercings looked really, really cool, too—or an indication that he was a power bottom. Either way, he was a true adventurer; his chitin and leather outfit looked sturdy but not too over-cumbering in its weight. “Y—yeah? That’s me.”
408420fe9aa7.t: Harry tidak bisa tidak menatap mohawk merah dan hijau yang tampak keren banget itu. Tindikan telinga keperakan yang mencolok juga tampak sangat, sangat keren—atau tanda bahwa ia seorang power bottom. Bagaimanapun juga, ia petualang sejati; pakaiannya dari kitin dan kulit tampak kokoh tetapi tidak terlalu berat. “I—iya? Itu aku.”

414c648c9ea8.en: The grandmotherly maid touched Harry’s forehead. “It’s okay, honey. Your body is still recovering. Take your time.”
414c648c9ea8.t: Pelayan bak nenek itu menyentuh dahi Harry. “Tidak apa-apa, sayang. Tubuhmu masih dalam pemulihan. Pelan-pelan saja.”

41ae51a51c68.en: Ohhh. This sucks! A sense of being overwhelmed as he tried to stay alive kept going, but it didn’t appear like he was on his last breath—maybe the last ones based on the agony. He tried breathing deeply again, but it didn’t hurt as much this time. He tried to lift his neck again; it was still cumbersome but not as heavy as before. His eyes were no longer sharp, but the blurry ceiling he stared at was familiar. He then turned his head towards the maid, immediately recognizing that he had seen her before when dining with the Sanbi royalty. The clothing reminded him of the other maids, including Sora. That suddenly caused him to catch a glimpse of the dream, or nightmare, or whatever it was, where Sora was washing his back with a massive grin on her noseless and eyeless face.
41ae51a51c68.t: Ohhh. Menyebalkan sekali! Perasaan kewalahan saat ia berusaha tetap hidup terus berlanjut, tetapi tampaknya ini bukan napas terakhirnya—mungkin napas-napas terakhir, kalau dilihat dari penderitaannya. Ia mencoba bernapas dalam lagi, tetapi kali ini tidak sesakit tadi. Ia mencoba mengangkat lehernya lagi; masih berat, tetapi tidak seberat tadi. Matanya tidak lagi tajam, tetapi langit-langit buram yang ia tatap terasa familier. Ia lalu menoleh ke arah pelayan itu, langsung mengenali bahwa ia pernah melihatnya saat makan bersama keluarga kerajaan Sanbi. Pakaiannya mengingatkannya pada pelayan-pelayan lain, termasuk Sora. Itu tiba-tiba membuatnya melihat sekilas mimpi itu, atau mimpi buruk, atau apa pun itu, di mana Sora sedang menggosok punggungnya dengan seringai lebar di wajahnya yang tanpa hidung dan tanpa mata.

4271f1081f6d.en: “Or if you want to hear Itagiba’s pep talk—” Eiri chuckled, deepening her voice, and slapping Harry on the shoulder. “Harry, my man!” Eiri grabbed his head from the top with a handful. “You need to get out of your own fucking head! You’re too deep inside! Don’t worry about it!”
4271f1081f6d.t: “Atau kalau kamu mau dengar pidato penyemangat ala Itagiba—” Eiri terkekeh, memperberat suaranya, dan menepuk bahu Harry. “Harry, Bro!” Eiri mencengkeram kepalanya dari atas dengan segenggam tangan. “Kau harus keluar dari kepalamu sendiri, bangsat! Kau terlalu dalam! Jangan dipikirkan!”

42ff5485c3d4.en: Eiri began leading Harry out of the room, pushing his back towards the door. “Let’s get you some water and food then! At least I can help with that!”
42ff5485c3d4.t: Eiri mulai menuntun Harry keluar ruangan, mendorong punggungnya ke arah pintu. “Kalau begitu ayo kita ambilkan air dan makanan untukmu! Setidaknya aku bisa membantu soal itu!”

441e26b31ebc.en: “Aiight. Come here!” Hiromi embraced Harry with a big brotherly hug. “Harry, or should I say Sanbi-eye? I hope you have tons of fun, my brotha! Next time I’m on a quest nearby, I will send you a winga mail for us to meet up!”
441e26b31ebc.t: “Oke. Sini!” Hiromi memeluk Harry dengan pelukan besar ala saudara. “Harry, atau harus kusebut Sanbi-eye? Semoga kau bersenang-senang banyak, Bro-ku! Lain kali aku sedang menjalankan misi di dekat sini, akan kukirim winga mail supaya kita bisa bertemu!”

453261752d4d.en: Hiromi placed one hand by his mouth while the other raised the jar towards the atrium. He shouted brightly, but still in the same deep, ultimatum-sounding voice, “Come drink with us too! The more, the merrier!”
453261752d4d.t: Hiromi meletakkan satu tangan di dekat mulutnya sementara tangan yang lain mengangkat toples ke arah atrium. Ia berteriak dengan riang, tetapi tetap dengan suara berat yang sama yang terdengar seperti ultimatum, “Ayo minum bersama kami juga! Makin ramai makin seru!”

45f1a1cba5d9.en: “Yea.” A loud womanly voice, slightly gurgly from perhaps taking a big gulp, echoed in the atrium through the half-open door. It was for sure Yacamim.
45f1a1cba5d9.t: “Ya.” Suara wanita yang keras, sedikit berdeguk mungkin karena menenggak banyak, menggema di atrium melalui pintu yang setengah terbuka. Itu jelas Yacamim.

469b47001d19.en: “YES! That’s how it’s done!” Hiromi let go of the pose and embraced Harry with a friendly, brotherly tight hug. “Glad you came back! Now let’s celebrate life!” Walking behind the bar, he perused around the alcohol cabinet. “Do you remember having lolish-floaters?”
469b47001d19.t: “YA! Begitu caranya!” Hiromi melepaskan pose itu dan memeluk Harry dengan pelukan erat yang ramah dan bersaudara. “Senang kau kembali! Sekarang ayo rayakan kehidupan!” Berjalan ke balik bar, ia melihat-lihat lemari minuman keras. “Kau ingat pernah minum lolish-floater?”

475542104620.en: A warm feeling arose in Harry, contrasting that annoying feeling lingering within. “Thanks, Eiri! I guess I will!”
475542104620.t: Perasaan hangat muncul dalam diri Harry, bertolak belakang dengan perasaan menjengkelkan yang tertinggal di dalam. “Terima kasih, Eiri! Kurasa akan kulakukan!”

491dfdd15f1f.en: Chuckling, Hiromi patted Harry on the back. “Just don’t breathe it in. Let it all out first. Good job! Good job!”
491dfdd15f1f.t: Terkekeh, Hiromi menepuk punggung Harry. “Jangan dihirup saja. Keluarkan semuanya dulu. Bagus! Bagus!”

493b20063ebd.en: Harry looked as if he had just come out of a stampede. “Arrggh—” His brain was overflowing with warnings—like suddenly, his brain stem, commonly known as the body’s autopilot, disengaged. Harry felt like he had to force himself to stay alive consciously. He felt like he was telling his weakened heart to keep pulsating as he manually tried to draw a pained, laborious breath. Amongst the warnings, an accompanying pressure and dull pain surfaced where his bladder was and radiated down to his privates. He tried to bend his neck forward to see better what was happening, but it felt like his head was as heavy as a solid iron ball.
493b20063ebd.t: Harry tampak seolah baru keluar dari amukan massa. “Arrggh—” Otaknya dibanjiri peringatan—seperti tiba-tiba, batang otaknya, yang biasa dikenal sebagai autopilot tubuh, lepas kendali. Harry merasa ia harus memaksa dirinya tetap hidup secara sadar. Ia merasa seolah sedang menyuruh jantungnya yang melemah untuk terus berdenyut sementara ia secara manual mencoba menarik napas yang menyakitkan dan berat. Di antara peringatan-peringatan itu, tekanan dan nyeri tumpul yang menyertainya muncul di tempat kandung kemihnya berada dan menjalar turun ke kemaluannya. Ia mencoba menekuk lehernya ke depan untuk melihat lebih jelas apa yang sedang terjadi, tetapi rasanya kepalanya seberat bola besi padat.

49b4d981b111.en: Hearing a boot clacking towards them, Harry glanced at it and saw a blurry of a maid that felt too familiar. Her unnaturally bright cyan eyes and red lips were unavoidable to look at. Her dark brown hair shone against the sun’s natural light poking through the atrium windows, while her almond skin added a mysterious beauty to her aura. The tight blue corset on top of the black clothing enhanced her natural curviness and the eye-magnet power of her breasts. It was none other than Arukia. The maid that teased him to no end. Does she really like me?
49b4d981b111.t: Mendengar sepatu bot berketuk mendekati mereka, Harry meliriknya dan melihat sosok buram seorang pelayan yang terasa terlalu familier. Mata sian cerahnya yang tidak wajar dan bibir merahnya mustahil untuk tidak dipandangi. Rambut cokelat gelapnya berkilau di bawah cahaya alami matahari yang menembus jendela-jendela atrium, sementara kulitnya yang berwarna almond menambah kecantikan misterius pada auranya. Korset biru yang ketat di atas pakaian hitamnya menonjolkan lekuk tubuhnya yang alami dan daya magnet payudaranya yang memikat mata. Siapa lagi kalau bukan Arukia. Pelayan yang menggodanya tanpa henti. Apa dia benar-benar suka padaku?

4a8e09d255d6.en: Eiri placed the amethyst on her desk. “That explains the bang I heard. Well, it’s not the first time he had to pay for stuff either—but he is the prince, so what can I do? Hmmm, at least he doesn’t wait until I generate an invoice like Itagiba.” Eiri placed her gloved hands on Harry’s shoulder, profoundly looking into his blue eyes. “But doing that wouldn’t cause your mood to swing like this, right? There’s something else you want to tell me about Sora? I already know you have the hots for her.”
4a8e09d255d6.t: Eiri meletakkan amethyst itu di mejanya. “Itu menjelaskan dentuman yang kudengar. Yah, ini juga bukan pertama kalinya dia harus membayar sesuatu—tapi dia pangeran, jadi apa yang bisa kulakukan? Hmmm, setidaknya dia tidak menunggu sampai aku membuat tagihan seperti Itagiba.” Eiri meletakkan tangannya yang bersarung di bahu Harry, menatap dalam-dalam mata birunya. “Tapi melakukan itu tidak akan membuat suasana hatimu berubah-ubah begini, kan? Ada hal lain yang ingin kamu katakan padaku soal Sora? Aku sudah tahu kamu naksir dia.”

4aae58e9719a.en: A burst of constrained laughter sounded from Eiri at first, but then it died down as she seemed to notice Harry wasn’t laughing. “Hmmmm—are you sure it is not a nightmare? Like a really vivid one? I mean, some would say that’s a wet dream—” A small smirk broke through the corner of Eiri’s mouth.
4aae58e9719a.t: Ledakan tawa yang tertahan terdengar dari Eiri awalnya, tetapi kemudian mereda saat ia tampaknya menyadari Harry tidak tertawa. “Hmmmm—kamu yakin itu bukan mimpi buruk? Semacam mimpi buruk yang sangat nyata? Maksudku, sebagian orang akan bilang itu mimpi basah—” Seringai kecil muncul di sudut mulut Eiri.

4b8ea4c4b749.en: “Pfff—there’s plenty of time! It’s only Sunnohigh! Celebrating life comes first!” Hiromi searched the cabinets down lower, making rustling noses, including a noise akin to opening and closing a chest freezer. “Aww. Yes! There you go! Fresh gyut, and lolish!” He pulled out two small wooden containers. One was filled to the brim with a fruit that looked like cherries but with color hues between red and orange spectrums, while the other was a piece of root that seemed pretty close to ginger. Hiromi checked the shaker Maiara had left behind but then shoved it aside and grabbed a far bigger one from the cabinet—capable of holding enough booze to make a typical human forget everything bad, good, or even life itself. Placing all the gyut berries inside, he grabbed a muddler and muddled the gyut as if they had dishonored his family.
4b8ea4c4b749.t: “Pfff—masih banyak waktu! Baru juga Sunnohigh! Merayakan kehidupan nomor satu!” Hiromi mencari-cari di lemari-lemari yang lebih bawah, menimbulkan bunyi berkeresek, termasuk bunyi seperti membuka dan menutup freezer peti. “Aww. Ya! Ini dia! Gyut segar, dan lolish!” Ia mengeluarkan dua wadah kayu kecil. Satu terisi penuh dengan buah yang tampak seperti ceri tetapi dengan rona warna di antara spektrum merah dan jingga, sementara yang lain berisi sepotong akar yang tampak cukup mirip jahe. Hiromi memeriksa shaker yang ditinggalkan Maiara tetapi lalu menyingkirkannya dan mengambil yang jauh lebih besar dari lemari—yang mampu menampung cukup banyak minuman keras untuk membuat manusia biasa melupakan segala hal buruk, baik, atau bahkan kehidupan itu sendiri. Memasukkan semua buah gyut ke dalamnya, ia mengambil penumbuk dan menumbuk gyut itu seolah buah-buah itu telah mempermalukan keluarganya.

4cd3d093a687.en: “Dunno—” Hiromi placed the balls back in the leather bag and shoved it up his skirt, hiding it somewhere most people wouldn’t dare touch. “But I have more drinking to do, and math ain’t my thing. You know where Eiri is?”
4cd3d093a687.t: “Entah—” Hiromi menaruh kembali bola-bola itu ke kantong kulit dan menjejalkannya ke balik roknya, menyembunyikannya di suatu tempat yang tidak berani disentuh kebanyakan orang. “Tapi aku masih mau minum lagi, dan matematika bukan keahlianku. Kau tahu Eiri di mana?”

502be943c9b9.en: “Brotha—you suck at this—Harry?” Hiromi held Harry; then, his eyes were wide open when he took notice of his paleness. His floppy ears then noticed a dreaded sound of retching coming out of Harry. “Ow, Harry! My brotha! Hold it! Hold it! HOLD IT!” With the same worried voice of a husband telling his wife going to labor to hold it just a few more seconds until they get to the hospital, Hiromi grabbed Harry and began to charge towards the atrium at full speed. Clashing against the door, smacking it wide open, he struck Harry’s head against the wall as he lost his balance; Hiromi didn’t even seem to notice it at first.
502be943c9b9.t: “Bro—kau payah dalam hal ini—Harry?” Hiromi memegangi Harry; lalu, matanya terbelalak saat menyadari betapa pucatnya ia. Telinganya yang terkulai lalu menangkap bunyi muntah yang mengerikan keluar dari Harry. “Oh, Harry! Bro-ku! Tahan! Tahan! TAHAN!” Dengan suara cemas yang sama seperti seorang suami yang menyuruh istrinya yang akan melahirkan untuk menahannya beberapa detik lagi sampai mereka tiba di rumah sakit, Hiromi meraih Harry dan mulai berlari ke arah atrium dengan kecepatan penuh. Menabrak pintu, mendobraknya terbuka lebar, ia membenturkan kepala Harry ke dinding saat kehilangan keseimbangan; Hiromi bahkan tampaknya tidak menyadarinya pada awalnya.

504b870496c7.en: Chapter I – What If? · Vol 2 - Lab Soreno · #HusbandOutWorld
504b870496c7.t: Bab I – Bagaimana Jika? · Jilid 2 - Soreno Percobaan · #HusbandOutWorld

5347164896c3.en: Feeling an ominous sensation invading his brain as Sora’s vicious grin lingered on his mind, a notoriously familiar sense of having just gulped five energy drinks at once struck him like a train. The wired feeling pushed his body to sit up, but as he groaned to do so, his body just tweaked slightly instead as this eerie feeling kept making his heart pound harder, at least as hard as it could pound. More memories began flashing back to him, including when Sora licked his neck during the check phase of the duel with Maiara. I need to tell Eiri! Harry fought his body to say or do something. His hands did go up a bit but then came back crashing down as he muttered, “H—w—”
5347164896c3.t: Merasakan sensasi yang tidak menyenangkan menyerbu otaknya sementara seringai keji Sora membekas di benaknya, perasaan yang sangat familier seperti baru menenggak lima minuman energi sekaligus menghantamnya seperti kereta. Perasaan tegang itu mendorong tubuhnya untuk duduk, tetapi saat ia mengerang untuk melakukannya, tubuhnya hanya sedikit tersentak sementara perasaan ganjil ini terus membuat jantungnya berdebar lebih keras, setidaknya sekeras yang bisa ia debarkan. Lebih banyak ingatan mulai berkelebat kembali kepadanya, termasuk saat Sora menjilat lehernya pada tahap pemeriksaan duel dengan Maiara. Aku harus memberi tahu Eiri! Harry melawan tubuhnya untuk mengatakan atau melakukan sesuatu. Tangannya memang naik sedikit, tetapi lalu jatuh kembali saat ia bergumam, “D—m—”

53640946b7c7.en: “Aurora Toleri—sorry. Sanbi. I lived over there for a long time. Pleased to meet you, Harry.” Aurora tipped her red thatch hat with a significant smile—one that enhanced her wrinkles but one that would make you beg to replace your grandmother with her.
53640946b7c7.t: “Aurora Toleri—maaf. Sanbi. Aku dulu lama tinggal di sana. Senang bertemu denganmu, Harry.” Aurora mengangkat topi jerami merahnya dengan senyum yang berarti—senyum yang mempertegas kerutannya tetapi juga senyum yang akan membuatmu memohon agar nenekmu diganti dengannya.

53eb02d0624e.en: Trying to surface the memories of the event also brought this anxiety and perturbed feeling alongside it. Harry tried to concentrate on the moment this girl went towards sitting on his face, but the memory seemed floaty, with details merging into one another. “A vicious smile? I’m—not—sure? Maybe long hair? Greenish? Darkish? Or was it short?” The nightmare, or whatever that vivid thing was, where Sora had a similar vicious smile, seemed to be interfering with the memory of the nightly attack as well, making the person who suffocated him appear even more so as an amalgamation of multiple people. “I can’t tell for sure—it’s all blurring together!”
53eb02d0624e.t: Mencoba memunculkan ingatan tentang kejadian itu juga membawa serta kecemasan dan perasaan resah. Harry mencoba berkonsentrasi pada saat gadis ini hendak menduduki wajahnya, tetapi ingatan itu tampak melayang-layang, dengan detail yang menyatu satu sama lain. “Senyum yang keji? Aku—tidak—yakin? Mungkin rambut panjang? Kehijauan? Agak gelap? Atau pendek?” Mimpi buruk itu, atau apa pun hal yang begitu nyata itu, di mana Sora memiliki senyum keji yang serupa, tampaknya juga mengganggu ingatan tentang serangan malam itu, membuat orang yang mencekiknya tampak semakin seperti gabungan dari beberapa orang. “Aku tidak bisa memastikan—semuanya campur aduk!”

56709ae305ee.en: “How are you feeling, honey?” A sweet grandmotherly voice spoke softly nearby. Her older gleeful appearance contrasted the wrinkles in her face, giving her a sense of tenured compassionate servitude. Her red thatch hat was just as bright as her cheery appearance, giving her maid-style black-with-blue-accent clothing a unique look as well. Her body had thicker proportions and well-endowed breasts, which she seemed proud of by wearing the same maid clothing as other far younger Sanbi maids. She masterfully crocheted away, waiting for Harry to regain his senses. “Looks like you had a nightmare, hon?” Her eyes noticed a bump on the sheets, coincidentally where Harry’s second brain would be. “Or a good dream?” Her sweet voice didn’t seem to imply anything—more like just treating whatever that bump was as a fact of life.
56709ae305ee.t: “Bagaimana perasaanmu, sayang?” Suara nenek yang manis berbicara lembut di dekatnya. Penampilannya yang lebih tua dan riang kontras dengan kerutan di wajahnya, memberinya kesan pengabdian penuh kasih yang sudah lama. Topi jerami merahnya secerah penampilannya yang ceria, memberi pakaian hitam beraksen biru bergaya pelayannya tampilan yang unik juga. Tubuhnya berproporsi lebih berisi dengan payudara montok, yang tampaknya ia banggakan dengan memakai pakaian pelayan yang sama seperti pelayan-pelayan Sanbi lain yang jauh lebih muda. Ia merajut dengan mahir, menunggu Harry sadar kembali. “Sepertinya kamu mimpi buruk, sayang?” Matanya memperhatikan tonjolan di seprai, kebetulan di tempat otak kedua Harry berada. “Atau mimpi indah?” Suaranya yang manis tampaknya tidak menyiratkan apa-apa—lebih seperti menganggap tonjolan apa pun itu sebagai kenyataan hidup saja.

58d5f98fc8e1.en: Oh shit. Harry remained frozen, “Eh—sorry? I-I don’t know. I-I—I just remember waking up a few days ago and—”
58d5f98fc8e1.t: Oh sial. Harry tetap membeku, “Eh—maaf? A-aku tidak tahu. A-aku—aku cuma ingat bangun beberapa hari lalu dan—”

59b5766ce5cf.en: Raising his empty beer mug and shaking it in the air towards an unsuspecting server, Hiromi’s lips longed for more happiness liquid. “Can’t argue with that—well, she ain’t looking towards here, so I’m gonna walk up there instead. Need anything?”
59b5766ce5cf.t: Mengangkat gelas birnya yang kosong dan mengguncangnya di udara ke arah pelayan yang tidak curiga, bibir Hiromi mendambakan lebih banyak cairan kebahagiaan. “Tidak bisa membantah itu—yah, dia tidak melihat ke sini, jadi aku saja yang ke sana. Butuh sesuatu?”

5e0e8b1a37e2.en: Hiromi stepped out of the room towards Arukia. His balance seemed slightly off, based on how he propped his hand on the doorframe as he stared Arukia down. “Say that to Yacamim’s face—she’s the next queen, after all.” His voice grew more profound.
5e0e8b1a37e2.t: Hiromi melangkah keluar ruangan ke arah Arukia. Keseimbangannya tampak sedikit goyah, kalau dilihat dari caranya menopang tangannya di kusen pintu sambil menatap tajam Arukia. “Katakan itu di depan muka Yacamim—bagaimanapun juga dia ratu berikutnya.” Suaranya semakin dalam.

5f143d6f9bda.en: With a messy spit take going everywhere, including Hiromi’s armor, Harry’s reddened face seemed lost at what to say amongst the coughing, trying to clear the invading alcohol to stop burning his lungs.
5f143d6f9bda.t: Dengan semburan minuman yang berantakan ke mana-mana, termasuk ke baju zirah Hiromi, wajah Harry yang memerah tampak bingung harus berkata apa di tengah batuknya, berusaha mengeluarkan alkohol yang menyerbu agar paru-parunya berhenti terbakar.

603f0445e50e.en: “Hmmmm—” Eiri pointed at the same ceiling with a smile. “Think of it this way—this ceiling style is more of a Sanbi thing, so it reinforces the point that you were not too far off from here. So who was doing that to you?”
603f0445e50e.t: “Hmmmm—” Eiri menunjuk langit-langit yang sama sambil tersenyum. “Coba pikirkan begini—gaya langit-langit ini lebih khas Sanbi, jadi itu memperkuat bahwa kamu tidak jauh dari sini. Jadi siapa yang melakukan itu padamu?”

61d229300a38.en: Ufff. This is really strong. Harry shook his head, trying to take another sip to see if it improved his situation. “I—” he coughed up. “Never seen—” He kept coughing. “—Yacamim before.”
61d229300a38.t: Ufff. Ini keras sekali. Harry menggeleng, mencoba menyesap lagi untuk melihat apakah keadaannya membaik. “Aku—” ia terbatuk. “Belum pernah lihat—” Ia terus terbatuk. “—Yacamim sebelumnya.”

635fff641df7.en: “Feeling better, honey?” The maid touched Harry’s neck and shoulder all over. “How’s your neck feeling?”
635fff641df7.t: “Merasa lebih baik, sayang?” Pelayan itu menyentuh leher dan bahu Harry di mana-mana. “Bagaimana rasanya lehermu?”

63c5b5009d97.en: With his blurry eyes, the board looked more like an avant-garde painting than a dartboard. With the set of colored darts in his hand, there was a feeling of familiarity. “Kinda? Was the board always this big and colored? I thought it was rounded too—” Harry pointed his hand towards the colored squares in the board, almost in reverence to its bright colorfulness. “OH YEAH! The center is worth more, right? Like we’re scoring to—three-sixty. Right? No less or more?” He squinted his eyes at the edge of the board but didn’t see any numbers whatsoever. Wait—Maybe one-eighty?
63c5b5009d97.t: Dengan matanya yang buram, papan itu tampak lebih seperti lukisan avant-garde daripada papan dart. Dengan seperangkat dart berwarna di tangannya, ada perasaan familier. “Agak? Apa papannya dari dulu sebesar dan seberwarna ini? Kukira bentuknya bundar juga—” Harry menunjuk dengan tangannya ke kotak-kotak berwarna di papan itu, hampir dengan penuh hormat pada warna-warninya yang cerah. “OH IYA! Bagian tengahnya nilainya lebih tinggi, kan? Seperti kita mencetak skor sampai—tiga ratus enam puluh. Kan? Tidak kurang atau lebih?” Ia menyipitkan mata ke tepi papan tetapi tidak melihat angka sama sekali. Tunggu—Mungkin seratus delapan puluh?

66e5bf35ab89.en: Uncaringly walking out of the bar, Yacamim had her back to Hiromi, but his guttural scream gave away his intention. Evading the brain-exploding punch at the last split second, she blocked two more punches from this massive humanoid, ready to tear her limb by limb. Everyone could hear her bones splitting and cracking with each blocking, yet she seemed to swallow the pain with ease.
66e5bf35ab89.t: Berjalan keluar dari bar dengan acuh tak acuh, Yacamim membelakangi Hiromi, tetapi teriakan paraunya membocorkan niatnya. Menghindari tinju peledak otak itu di sepersekian detik terakhir, ia menangkis dua tinju lagi dari humanoid raksasa ini, yang siap mencabik-cabiknya satu per satu. Semua orang bisa mendengar tulang-tulangnya retak dan berderak di setiap tangkisan, namun ia tampaknya menelan rasa sakit itu dengan mudah.

674d871246bd.en: “Are you retarded? I’m Yacamim.” The girl finished pouring herself a bright green drink. Her hair was loose rather than tied in a pigtail. Her blue base cloth with leather overalls clothing seemed close to Maiara’s, but not quite the same. It also looked really pristine, like she had just bought it. Not even caring to make eye contact, Yacamim stuck her finger in the drink, gave it a nice swirl, then sucked it clean before hamming a large gulp down.
674d871246bd.t: “Kau idiot, ya? Aku Yacamim.” Gadis itu selesai menuang minuman hijau terang untuk dirinya sendiri. Rambutnya tergerai alih-alih diikat kuncir. Pakaiannya yang berbahan dasar biru dengan terusan kulit tampak mirip dengan milik Maiara, tetapi tidak persis sama. Pakaian itu juga tampak sangat bersih, seolah ia baru membelinya. Bahkan tanpa peduli untuk melakukan kontak mata, Yacamim mencelupkan jarinya ke minuman itu, mengaduknya, lalu mengisap jarinya sampai bersih sebelum menenggak satu tegukan besar.

67a2e0505316.en: Taking a large sip from the jar, Hiromi let out a burp. “I gotta say, from all my traveling around—Sanbi people are always ready to enjoy watching shit going down. Except her! She needs to loosen up a bit, amirite?”
67a2e0505316.t: Menyesap banyak dari toples itu, Hiromi bersendawa. “Harus kubilang, dari semua perjalananku—orang Sanbi selalu siap menikmati tontonan kekacauan. Kecuali dia! Dia harus sedikit lebih santai, betul tidak?”

6825c630df98.en: Harry gleaned his blurry eyesight towards the familiar black and blue clothing, trying to recognize the taller girl, or maybe girls, wearing it—at first, it appeared like there were two maids, but then it clicked that it had to be the one and only maid Itanema. Do I even know other people named like that? Eiri! Something else far more pressing came to mind. “OH SHIT! I’m sorry!” Harry tried to chug the rest of his drink, but it spilled down his face and onto his clothes.
6825c630df98.t: Harry mengarahkan penglihatannya yang buram ke pakaian hitam dan biru yang familier, mencoba mengenali gadis yang lebih tinggi, atau mungkin gadis-gadis, yang memakainya—awalnya tampak ada dua pelayan, tetapi kemudian ia sadar pasti itu satu-satunya pelayan Itanema. Apa aku kenal orang lain yang namanya begitu? Eiri! Sesuatu yang jauh lebih mendesak terlintas di benaknya. “OH SIAL! Maaf!” Harry mencoba menenggak habis sisa minumannya, tetapi minuman itu tumpah ke wajah dan pakaiannya.

682f2ec04455.en: Harry shook his head, his droopy eyes searching for any other person in the room as his voice gathered its will. “I-I thought I had this dream, but—but now I know that it wasn’t one—I think—ahh—it actually happened. Remember during the duel when Sora mentioned my neck?”
682f2ec04455.t: Harry menggeleng, matanya yang sayu mencari orang lain di ruangan itu sementara suaranya mengumpulkan tekad. “A-aku kira aku bermimpi, tapi—tapi sekarang aku tahu itu bukan mimpi—kurasa—ahh—itu benar-benar terjadi. Ingat waktu duel ketika Sora menyebut-nyebut leherku?”

689e8fc71e36.en: “We all play at the same time. GO!” Hiromi threw a dart, making it land on another purple. He then kept throwing darts as if his life depended on it; with each throw, sweat began dripping on his forehead.
689e8fc71e36.t: “Kita semua main bersamaan. AYO!” Hiromi melempar sebatang dart, membuatnya mendarat di ungu yang lain. Ia lalu terus melempar dart seolah hidupnya bergantung padanya; di setiap lemparan, keringat mulai menetes di dahinya.

692e5b4de578.en: “Maybe?” Hiromi finished his drink with a nice chug. “I mean, not everyone can handle your sassiness.” He belly laughed, letting his tusks enhance his wide grin.
692e5b4de578.t: “Mungkin?” Hiromi menghabiskan minumannya dengan tenggakan yang enak. “Maksudku, tidak semua orang tahan dengan kelancanganmu.” Ia tertawa terbahak-bahak, membiarkan taringnya mempertegas seringainya yang lebar.

694d4236f9f8.en: “You forgot about the balls currency too?” Hiromi seemed ready to give a brotherly goodbye hug, but perhaps seeing Harry bringing the amethyst ball to his eyes like a kid would pick up a frog off the street and scientifically analyze it, he opened his leather bag again. “I don’t have any sapphires—I don’t think I—oh, there it is!” Hiromi pulled out a single aquamarine, then a few pearls—all the same size, with the same golden metal crust—and brought them closer to Harry’s squinting eyes. “Fifty pearls is one amethyst. Ten amethysts is one aquamarine, and ten aquamarines is one sapphire.”
694d4236f9f8.t: “Kau lupa soal mata uang bola juga?” Hiromi tampak siap memberi pelukan perpisahan ala saudara, tetapi mungkin melihat Harry mendekatkan bola amethyst itu ke matanya seperti anak kecil yang memungut katak dari jalan dan menganalisisnya secara ilmiah, ia membuka lagi kantong kulitnya. “Aku tidak punya sapphire—kurasa aku tidak—oh, ini dia!” Hiromi mengeluarkan sebuah aquamarine tunggal, lalu beberapa pearl—semuanya berukuran sama, dengan balutan logam emas yang sama—dan mendekatkannya ke mata Harry yang menyipit. “Lima puluh pearl sama dengan satu amethyst. Sepuluh amethyst sama dengan satu aquamarine, dan sepuluh aquamarine sama dengan satu sapphire.”

69919e34ad54.en: Harry felt like a knife had been shoved into his heart when he saw Arukia’s reaction. He couldn’t do anything but look down as he felt like he wanted to curl up into a ball and disappear out of her sight.
69919e34ad54.t: Harry merasa seolah pisau ditancapkan ke jantungnya saat melihat reaksi Arukia. Ia tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa selain menunduk karena ia merasa ingin meringkuk seperti bola dan menghilang dari pandangannya.

69c0c1e139cd.en: “We just kept going on the brawl. I thought I had it in the bag, but she quickly learned my body cues, even my fakeouts. For a Naked Bruntos, a female Naked Bruntos, mind ya, her kicks were out of this world!” Hiromi placed his hand on the right of his belly, the upper right region. “She did get one right in my liver that I still remember to this day. She thought I was done for, but that’s when I took the opportunity and charged her with my shoulder.” Hiromi took another sip, taking the time to chew on a few sliced lolish roots. “My memory is foggy after falling on the ground and bashing my head, but I for sure remembered when the room got rowdy when we started making out.” Hiromi grew even redder in the face as he stared into the distance. “I can’t even remember who started it, but yea.”
69c0c1e139cd.t: “Kami terus saja berkelahi. Kukira aku sudah pasti menang, tapi dia cepat mempelajari isyarat tubuhku, bahkan tipuan-tipuanku. Untuk ukuran Naked Bruntos, Naked Bruntos perempuan, ingat, tendangannya luar biasa!” Hiromi meletakkan tangannya di kanan perutnya, di bagian kanan atas. “Dia memang berhasil menendang tepat di hatiku, yang masih kuingat sampai hari ini. Dia kira aku sudah habis, tapi saat itulah aku mengambil kesempatan dan menerjangnya dengan bahuku.” Hiromi menyesap lagi, meluangkan waktu untuk mengunyah beberapa irisan akar lolish. “Ingatanku kabur setelah jatuh ke lantai dan kepalaku terbentur, tapi aku jelas ingat saat ruangan jadi riuh waktu kami mulai bercumbu.” Wajah Hiromi semakin memerah saat ia menatap ke kejauhan. “Aku bahkan tidak ingat siapa yang memulai, tapi ya begitulah.”

69cb058cc2d5.en: Harry stood up as well. “Ohhhhh!” His legs were wobbly, and the room felt like he was on a boat, but his steps seemed firm enough that he could walk towards Hiromi. “Oookay!” He could feel the booze slouching in his stomach with every step he took.
69cb058cc2d5.t: Harry juga berdiri. “Ohhhhh!” Kakinya goyah, dan ruangan terasa seperti ia sedang di perahu, tetapi langkahnya tampak cukup mantap sehingga ia bisa berjalan ke arah Hiromi. “Oookeee!” Ia bisa merasakan minuman keras itu berguncang di perutnya setiap kali ia melangkah.

6aabf1a8e8cd.en: With bright eyes of her own, Eiri, also commonly referred to as king-maid, smiled back at Harry. “How are you feeling, Harry? Or should I say Sanbi-eye?” As she was sitting in her comfortable chair, one of her eyebrows rose as she curiously glanced at the single amethyst ball in his hand. “Hmmm—whatcha got there?”
6aabf1a8e8cd.t: Dengan mata yang juga cerah, Eiri, yang juga biasa disebut king-maid, membalas senyum Harry. “Bagaimana perasaanmu, Harry? Atau harus kusebut Sanbi-eye?” Saat ia duduk di kursinya yang nyaman, salah satu alisnya terangkat saat ia melirik dengan penasaran bola amethyst tunggal di tangannya. “Hmmm—apa itu yang kamu bawa?”

6b09e8183fc0.en: With a click of the tongue, Arukia clapped back with a sarcastic tone, “That’s not an excuse to blow the door apart!” She stood at where the door was, looking around the bathroom for something, then suddenly her sensual red lips formed a smirk—it appeared as if she was readying herself for a mic drop with the same energy of a rapper about to fire a you-momma joke in a rap duel. She picked a piece of a doorframe from the floor with a partial imprint of a nonhuman-sized foot with clear indents of a spiked boot. “That’s all the proof I need to make you never set foot here again!” She hid the piece behind her, winking at Hiromi as she stepped backward. “I’m sure I can even get him as an accomplice.”
6b09e8183fc0.t: Dengan decakan lidah, Arukia membalas dengan nada sarkastis, “Itu bukan alasan untuk menghancurkan pintunya!” Ia berdiri di tempat pintu tadi berada, memandang sekeliling kamar mandi mencari sesuatu, lalu tiba-tiba bibir merahnya yang sensual membentuk seringai—tampaknya ia sedang bersiap melakukan mic drop dengan energi yang sama seperti rapper yang akan melontarkan lelucon soal ibu dalam duel rap. Ia memungut sepotong kusen pintu dari lantai yang memiliki sebagian cetakan kaki berukuran bukan manusia dengan lekukan jelas dari sepatu bot berpaku. “Itu semua bukti yang kubutuhkan untuk membuatmu tidak pernah menginjakkan kaki di sini lagi!” Ia menyembunyikan potongan itu di belakangnya, mengedipkan mata kepada Hiromi sambil melangkah mundur. “Aku yakin aku bahkan bisa menjadikan dia sebagai kaki tangan.”

6b929ece5188.en: With the somehow still intact muddler set aside, Hiromi went after the lolish root next, pulling out a smaller mandoline slicer from a specific cabinet below without even having to search. The slicer was made out of slightly discolored wood with a steel blade in the center that had seen better days—it looked ready to be retired, but the beautiful green and blue tribal carvings built into it were probably the reason it was still in use.
6b929ece5188.t: Dengan penumbuk yang entah bagaimana masih utuh disingkirkan, Hiromi menyasar akar lolish berikutnya, mengeluarkan pengiris mandolin yang lebih kecil dari lemari tertentu di bawah bahkan tanpa harus mencari. Pengiris itu terbuat dari kayu yang agak pudar warnanya dengan bilah baja di tengahnya yang sudah melewati masa jayanya—tampak siap dipensiunkan, tetapi ukiran suku hijau dan biru yang indah yang menyatu dengannya mungkin alasan pengiris itu masih dipakai.

6ca539fb6514.en: “Then bring Eiri down here! We’re having fun, right, Harry?” With a charming but still kinda threatening look, Hiromi looked back at Harry. Perhaps the terrifying part was due to his heavy, warm hand weighing down on Harry’s shoulder like a sack of potatoes.
6ca539fb6514.t: “Kalau begitu bawa Eiri turun ke sini! Kami sedang bersenang-senang, kan, Harry?” Dengan tatapan menawan tetapi tetap agak mengancam, Hiromi kembali memandang Harry. Mungkin bagian menakutkannya karena tangannya yang berat dan hangat menekan bahu Harry seperti sekarung kentang.

6d2d3e86641c.en: “Me neither, to be honest!” Eiri pursed her lips as she held her arms tightly. “I believe you suffered abuse at some point in your life, probably in the Sanbi slums, before Gabiro did something to your soul. It’s like what they say—painful memories are easier to remember than happier ones, so there’s a chance that you didn’t lose your memories but they are locked away instead because they were too painful! Honestly, I don’t know why someone would do such an unacceptable thing!” Eiri gasped as she seemed to cheer up; she stood up and looked brightly at Harry’s eyes like she had owned the lotto. “That’s it! That’s the ticket to remember where you came from! Do you remember any characteristics of the person? Or exactly where it happened?”
6d2d3e86641c.t: “Aku juga tidak, jujur saja!” Eiri mengerucutkan bibirnya sambil memeluk lengannya erat-erat. “Aku yakin kamu pernah mengalami kekerasan di suatu titik dalam hidupmu, mungkin di permukiman kumuh Sanbi, sebelum Gabiro melakukan sesuatu pada jiwamu. Seperti kata orang—ingatan yang menyakitkan lebih mudah diingat daripada yang membahagiakan, jadi ada kemungkinan kamu tidak kehilangan ingatanmu tapi ingatan itu malah terkunci karena terlalu menyakitkan! Jujur saja, aku tidak tahu kenapa ada orang yang mau melakukan hal yang tidak bisa diterima seperti itu!” Eiri tersentak saat ia tampak bersemangat; ia berdiri dan memandang mata Harry dengan cerah seolah ia baru menang lotre. “Itu dia! Itu kunci untuk mengingat dari mana kamu berasal! Apa kamu ingat ciri-ciri orang itu? Atau persisnya di mana itu terjadi?”

7027f60219eb.en: As he reddened in the face as well, Harry’s heart didn’t know whether to pound in fear or race in passion. His brain swirled in a mix of emotions as his mouth moved to say something to Sora, but no words came out.
7027f60219eb.t: Wajahnya ikut memerah, jantung Harry tidak tahu apakah harus berdebam karena takut atau berpacu karena gairah. Otaknya berputar dalam campuran emosi sementara mulutnya bergerak untuk mengatakan sesuatu kepada Sora, tetapi tidak ada kata yang keluar.

70cd8a5c7c72.en: “Just leave him be.” Hiromi watched him disappear out of the door. “He didn’t speak his mind, but I guess not saying anything is also saying something?”
70cd8a5c7c72.t: “Biarkan saja dia.” Hiromi memperhatikannya menghilang di balik pintu. “Dia tidak mengutarakan pikirannya, tapi kurasa tidak mengatakan apa-apa juga berarti mengatakan sesuatu?”

716c40ea4afa.en: WAIT! Harry looked at Sora’s cutesy petite body, glancing at her hand, which was moving quickly through an abacus while the other hand was writing down things and her eyes were scouring through lines of a receipt. Was it her? His blurry eyes focused on Sora’s thin lips, comparing it to the vicious grin of the girl suffocating him in his memories. Maybe it had something to do with his lingering buzz, but something suddenly clicked deep in his mind—something isn’t right! The person that did that didn’t have tusks! The red thingy in the arm—yea! Darfaries interface! The person didn’t have that either! It can’t be Sora after all—wait—why did I think it could be her in the first place? Harry kept staring at Sora, his eyes duller than before, as his hands lowered on his own, hiding away the amethyst ball. Then who was it? He openly stared back at Eiri, observing her developing a slightly mischievous smirk; his mind drew blank in an attempt to refuse to believe she was the one.
716c40ea4afa.t: TUNGGU! Harry memandang tubuh mungil Sora yang imut, melirik tangannya, yang bergerak cepat di atas sempoa sementara tangan yang lain mencatat sesuatu dan matanya menyisir baris-baris sebuah kuitansi. Apa itu dia? Matanya yang buram berfokus pada bibir tipis Sora, membandingkannya dengan seringai keji gadis yang mencekiknya dalam ingatannya. Mungkin ada hubungannya dengan sisa mabuknya, tetapi sesuatu tiba-tiba terlintas jauh di benaknya—ada yang tidak beres! Orang yang melakukan itu tidak punya taring! Benda merah di lengan—iya! Antarmuka Darfaries! Orang itu juga tidak punya itu! Tidak mungkin Sora kalau begitu—tunggu—kenapa aku mengira itu bisa saja dia dari awal? Harry terus menatap Sora, matanya lebih redup dari sebelumnya, sementara tangannya turun sendiri, menyembunyikan bola amethyst itu. Lalu siapa? Ia terang-terangan menatap kembali Eiri, memperhatikan Eiri mulai menyunggingkan seringai yang agak nakal; pikirannya kosong dalam upaya menolak percaya bahwa Eiri-lah orangnya.

7355b52de6df.en: “Not only did we not make any profit; now we’re wasting personal funds here! We need to be out there!” Kaiana waved outwardly, letting her unnatural gift jiggly around freely.
7355b52de6df.t: “Bukan hanya kita tidak dapat untung sama sekali; sekarang kita malah membuang dana pribadi di sini! Kita harus berada di luar sana!” Kaiana melambai ke arah luar, membiarkan anugerahnya yang tidak wajar berguncang bebas.

73b942e75f4f.en: Doing so, Harry felt his throat burn just as much as when the alcohol was going in. He could feel the waves of vomit swelling deep in his gut, powerless to stop it. It felt like the stomach was puppeteering his whole body; all he could do was fight the urge to breathe.
73b942e75f4f.t: Melakukannya, Harry merasakan tenggorokannya terbakar sama hebatnya seperti saat alkohol itu masuk. Ia bisa merasakan gelombang muntahan membengkak jauh di dalam perutnya, tak berdaya menghentikannya. Rasanya seperti perut yang mengendalikan seluruh tubuhnya seperti boneka; yang bisa ia lakukan hanyalah melawan dorongan untuk bernapas.

73ca5d1d2532.en: “And for what end? To have this dead meat drain all my nari stones?” Kaiana slapped hard on the table, making a nice echo in the bar and catching a few glimpses that didn’t seem to care about her babbling—but were interested in her jiggling. She looked towards Takeo with a bitter dammed smile—the kind of smile that a boy will never forget because that’s when they realize they goofed it up and there’s no taking back.
73ca5d1d2532.t: “Dan untuk apa? Supaya si daging mati ini menghabiskan semua batu nariku?” Kaiana menepuk meja dengan keras, menimbulkan gema yang enak di bar dan menarik beberapa lirikan yang tampaknya tidak peduli dengan ocehannya—tetapi tertarik dengan guncangannya. Ia memandang ke arah Takeo dengan senyum getir yang terbendung—jenis senyum yang tidak akan pernah dilupakan seorang laki-laki karena saat itulah mereka sadar mereka sudah mengacau dan tidak bisa ditarik kembali.

75d376e17b6f.en: With this opening, Hiromi then punched squarely on Yacamim’s face, throwing her backward. “Not bad for a human girl!” He made a low, hoarse belly laugh as he saw Yacamim splattered on the floor with a flattened nose just like his.
75d376e17b6f.t: Dengan celah ini, Hiromi lalu meninju tepat di wajah Yacamim, membuatnya terpental ke belakang. “Lumayan untuk ukuran gadis manusia!” Ia tertawa rendah dan serak terbahak-bahak saat melihat Yacamim tergeletak di lantai dengan hidung remuk persis seperti miliknya.

797dff9efe68.en: “Yea. You can take that to your soul death.” Hiromi clacked his jar on Harry’s glass. “But anyways, you want to hear the end?”
797dff9efe68.t: “Iya. Kau bisa pegang kata-kataku sampai kematian jiwamu.” Hiromi membenturkan toplesnya ke gelas Harry. “Tapi omong-omong, kau mau dengar akhirnya?”

7b88a2b56597.en: The caring eyes of this older maid looked up to the ceiling in search of an answer. “Today is Tollday—oh! She’s getting caught up with paperwork with Sora.”
7b88a2b56597.t: Mata penuh perhatian pelayan tua ini mendongak ke langit-langit mencari jawaban. “Hari ini Tollday—oh! Dia sedang menyelesaikan urusan administrasi bersama Sora.”

7c99ab10a343.en: Homeegg? Huh—interesting. Harry did as told, but now he no longer had the same belly as before, so there was so much puffing out he could do.
7c99ab10a343.t: Homeegg? Hah—menarik. Harry melakukan apa yang disuruh, tetapi sekarang ia tidak lagi punya perut seperti dulu, jadi tidak banyak yang bisa ia busungkan.

7ee8a1f3a494.en: With a hearty amount of booze in his hand, Harry brought it close to his nose. The smell of something akin to gin mixed with vodka was strong, but it went along nicely with the fruit’s tropical, tart, sweet smell. Meanwhile, the gingery aroma of the lolish kinda went along with the rest—like the ginger that comes with sushi. Although, usually, those are a palate cleanser between shoving sushi into your gullet, not part of the experience per se. Cheering with Hiromi, he brought the drink to his mouth and sipped. OH FUCK! Harry’s mouth felt like it was on fire, and the source of the fire was now invading his throat, choking him. His breath felt like he was inhaling ghost peppers.
7ee8a1f3a494.t: Dengan minuman keras dalam jumlah banyak di tangannya, Harry mendekatkannya ke hidungnya. Bau sesuatu yang mirip gin bercampur vodka begitu kuat, tetapi berpadu dengan baik dengan aroma buah yang tropis, asam, dan manis. Sementara itu, aroma lolish yang seperti jahe agak berpadu dengan yang lainnya—seperti jahe yang disajikan bersama sushi. Walaupun, biasanya, jahe itu untuk menetralkan lidah di sela-sela menjejalkan sushi ke kerongkongan, bukan bagian dari pengalaman itu sendiri. Bersulang dengan Hiromi, ia mendekatkan minuman itu ke mulutnya dan menyesapnya. OH BANGSAT! Mulut Harry terasa terbakar, dan sumber apinya kini menyerbu tenggorokannya, mencekiknya. Napasnya terasa seperti menghirup cabai ghost pepper.

7f1d2478f476.en: Doing as told, Harry used all of his strength to launch the dart, but his hand held it for too long, making the dart fly towards the wall and lodging itself below the dart board. Harry’s body almost fell forward, but he caught himself on his knees and held it there for a bit as the feeling of falling forward kept happening.
7f1d2478f476.t: Menurut, Harry mengerahkan seluruh tenaganya untuk meluncurkan dart itu, tetapi tangannya menahannya terlalu lama, membuat dart itu melayang ke dinding dan menancap di bawah papan dart. Tubuh Harry hampir jatuh ke depan, tetapi ia menahan dirinya di lututnya dan bertahan di sana sebentar sementara rasa akan jatuh ke depan terus terjadi.

7f3083611fd0.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 6: Harry grins at the blonde girl and the red-haired maid at a shop counter, with dresses on mannequins behind.
7f3083611fd0.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 6: Harry menyeringai kepada gadis pirang dan pelayan berambut merah di meja toko, dengan gaun-gaun di manekin di belakangnya.

7f7e090b255e.en: Harry smiled softly as his head rested on her warm shoulder. “Thanks, Eiri! I don’t know either, but once in a while, I have this thing inside me that makes me feel like my heart is about to explode if I don’t do something about it. But I just don’t know what to do!”
7f7e090b255e.t: Harry tersenyum lembut sementara kepalanya bersandar di bahunya yang hangat. “Terima kasih, Eiri! Aku juga tidak tahu, tapi sesekali, ada sesuatu di dalam diriku yang membuatku merasa jantungku akan meledak kalau aku tidak melakukan sesuatu. Tapi aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa!”

8062c0d26aea.en: Meanwhile, Harry remained sitting, silently appreciating the showmanship displayed as Hiromi finished swinging the shaker widely, then not so masterfully poured the contents into two glass containers—a mug that would get you drunk and a jar that would put you in a coffin. Finally, he tried to pick up the sliced lolish roots with his big fingers, but they kept slipping through—the table and his hands were soaked in booze.
8062c0d26aea.t: Sementara itu, Harry tetap duduk, diam-diam mengagumi pertunjukan yang ditampilkan saat Hiromi selesai mengayun-ayunkan shaker dengan lebar, lalu dengan tidak terlalu mahir menuangkan isinya ke dua wadah kaca—sebuah gelas besar yang bisa membuatmu mabuk dan sebuah toples yang bisa memasukkanmu ke peti mati. Terakhir, ia mencoba mengambil irisan akar lolish dengan jari-jarinya yang besar, tetapi irisan itu terus tergelincir—meja dan tangannya basah kuyup oleh minuman keras.

821a7e56eea3.en: With his hands up and feet spread apart, the humanoid mountain of muscle began approaching him and spreading his feet even more apart in an attempt to level the plane field—as in trying to touch belly to belly, hand to hand. He then stared at Harry’s eyes with a display of willpower that looked like he was about to declare, DESTROY ALL HUMANS!
821a7e56eea3.t: Dengan tangan terangkat dan kaki direnggangkan, gunung otot humanoid itu mulai mendekatinya dan merenggangkan kakinya lebih jauh lagi dalam upaya menyamakan ketinggian—dalam arti mencoba menempelkan perut ke perut, tangan ke tangan. Ia lalu menatap mata Harry dengan pertunjukan tekad yang tampak seolah ia akan menyatakan, HANCURKAN SEMUA MANUSIA!

826d9a8b25b3.en: Arukia tilted her head up to look at Hiromi; his cheeks and ears were plump and red, but his eyes, mouth, and even tusks looked ready to throw down. With a huff from his nose, Hiromi looked downright threatening—like she was staring at a bull ready to charge. Arukia did another click of her tongue as her eyes rolled back in her head. With her free hand, she waved Hiromi off. “That’s the best you got? You and Yacamim are barely here—why would they hand you the monarchy department?” Pointing back to the parlor, she drilled her finale statement with a gotcha smile, “You only show up because of the open bar!” She then pointed at a boxy contraption resting above Harry. “Get him some soap!”
826d9a8b25b3.t: Arukia mendongakkan kepalanya untuk memandang Hiromi; pipi dan telinganya tembam dan merah, tetapi mata, mulut, dan bahkan taringnya tampak siap berkelahi. Dengan dengusan dari hidungnya, Hiromi tampak benar-benar mengancam—seolah ia sedang menatap banteng yang siap menyeruduk. Arukia berdecak lagi sementara matanya berputar ke belakang. Dengan tangannya yang bebas, ia mengibaskan Hiromi. “Cuma itu yang kau punya? Kau dan Yacamim hampir tidak pernah di sini—kenapa mereka mau menyerahkan departemen monarki padamu?” Menunjuk kembali ke ruang duduk, ia menancapkan pernyataan pamungkasnya dengan senyum kena-kau, “Kau cuma muncul karena minumannya gratis!” Ia lalu menunjuk sebuah alat berbentuk kotak yang terletak di atas Harry. “Ambilkan dia sabun!”

844aca4f77af.en: “Why do you expect me to be all happy and shit about this?” Kaiana spoke up gratingly, waiting for an answer as she sipped her beer. She was a woman of minor port gifted with cutesy, youthful attributes and spirited energy, somehow endowed by disproportionately large breasts that attracted attention whenever she went—or known as Oppai Loli for the cultured ones.
844aca4f77af.t: “Kenapa kau berharap aku senang dan sebagainya soal ini?” Kaiana berbicara dengan nada menjengkelkan, menunggu jawaban sambil menyesap birnya. Ia seorang wanita bertubuh mungil yang dianugerahi ciri-ciri imut, awet muda, dan energi yang penuh semangat, entah bagaimana dikaruniai payudara besar yang tidak proporsional yang menarik perhatian ke mana pun ia pergi—atau dikenal sebagai Oppai Loli bagi kalangan berbudaya.

846e98f11e19.en: “I’m not hungry.” Kaiana stood up, adjusting her large wizard-like white-with-black-and-red-accents hat, then her alluring tight-fitting color-coordinated clothing that revealed her slender belly with a perfect belly button. “Thanks for the beer, Hiromi! Send me a winga mail if you do find someone that doesn’t suck as much! I will do the same if I come across a decent party.”
846e98f11e19.t: “Aku tidak lapar.” Kaiana berdiri, membetulkan topi besarnya yang mirip topi penyihir berwarna putih beraksen hitam dan merah, lalu pakaiannya yang ketat dan memikat dengan warna yang serasi yang memperlihatkan perutnya yang ramping dengan pusar yang sempurna. “Terima kasih birnya, Hiromi! Kirimi aku winga mail kalau kau menemukan seseorang yang tidak separah itu! Aku akan melakukan hal yang sama kalau aku menemukan kelompok yang lumayan.”

8760cd588ad5.en: “That’s the spirit!” Finishing his massive booze jar with one gigantic gulp, Hiromi stuck it hard on the table, then stood up and stumbled towards the bags of different colored darts hanging on a nearby wall.
8760cd588ad5.t: “Itu baru semangat!” Menghabiskan toples minuman kerasnya yang raksasa dengan satu tegukan raksasa, Hiromi membantingnya keras ke meja, lalu berdiri dan terhuyung-huyung menuju kantong-kantong dart berbagai warna yang tergantung di dinding di dekatnya.

8762e23e0ecd.en: “You already have Yacamim!” With a reddening face, Arukia put the piece of the door she held in front of her, then threw it at Hiromi’s feet as she backed away, her hands holding her chest.
8762e23e0ecd.t: “Kau sudah punya Yacamim!” Dengan wajah memerah, Arukia menyodorkan potongan pintu yang ia pegang di depannya, lalu melemparkannya ke kaki Hiromi sambil mundur, tangannya memegangi dadanya.

878207899072.en: “Might as well eat my fill.” Hiromi walked with his empty mug towards the bar when his eyes caught a glimpse of a well-built guy with fantastic long, voluptuous blackish purple hair. He gawked at his shining hair, touching his own perfectly cared-for mohawk to compare. “BROTHA! YOUR HAIR IS AMAZING!” He grabbed this guy’s shoulder as he rested his body against the wooden countertop, clacking his chitin armor. “What do you—OHH NO!” Hiromi’s pupils flared up, realizing his grave mistake.
878207899072.t: “Sekalian saja aku makan sampai kenyang.” Hiromi berjalan dengan gelas kosongnya ke arah bar ketika matanya menangkap sekilas seorang pria bertubuh atletis dengan rambut ungu kehitaman yang panjang dan bervolume luar biasa. Ia terpana memandangi rambutnya yang berkilau, menyentuh mohawknya sendiri yang terawat sempurna untuk membandingkan. “BRO! RAMBUTMU LUAR BIASA!” Ia memegang bahu pria ini saat ia menyandarkan tubuhnya ke meja kayu, membuat baju zirah kitinnya berderak. “Kau pakai ap—OHH TIDAK!” Pupil Hiromi membesar, menyadari kesalahannya yang fatal.

88107cfc344d.en: Next in line was a specific bottle containing a clear white spirit Hiromi grabbed from the alcohol cabinet behind him—it had a small handwritten label hanging from the side, looking like it was either a small batch or homemade production. Pouring the whole thing into the shaker, he gave a silent sign to Harry as he placed the empty bottle back on the cabinet; he grabbed another clear white spirit that looked similar and kept pouring until the shaker was overflowing. He tightly capped it with the strainer and cap, and then began to shake the shit out of it with ultrawide motions that would for sure make an ordinary person strain—if his hands slipped up at any point, booze and fruit flesh would have painted the walls, floor, and ceiling of the parlor. One could safely presume it would cause enough grief for Eiri to snap, flip her shit, and cut Hiromi’s balls off.
88107cfc344d.t: Berikutnya adalah sebuah botol tertentu berisi minuman keras bening yang diambil Hiromi dari lemari minuman di belakangnya—ada label kecil tulisan tangan yang tergantung di sampingnya, tampak seperti produksi kecil atau buatan rumahan. Menuang seluruh isinya ke shaker, ia memberi isyarat diam kepada Harry sambil menaruh kembali botol kosong itu di lemari; ia mengambil minuman keras bening lain yang tampak serupa dan terus menuang sampai shaker itu meluap. Ia menutupnya rapat-rapat dengan saringan dan tutupnya, lalu mulai mengocoknya habis-habisan dengan gerakan sangat lebar yang pasti akan membuat orang biasa kewalahan—kalau tangannya terpeleset kapan saja, minuman keras dan daging buah pasti sudah mengecat dinding, lantai, dan langit-langit ruang duduk itu. Bisa dengan aman diduga itu akan menimbulkan cukup banyak masalah sampai Eiri meledak, mengamuk, dan memotong biji peler Hiromi.

8b332d786fe9.en: Harry let out a phlegm that looked like a slime you would fight in a JRPG game—if you looked closely, you could almost see it coming alive and awaiting its turn to attack. With narrow eyes and curled-up lips, Harry felt a wave of gagging coming in the distance in response to the foul salty taste, but the sensation of being able to breathe freely counterbalanced it.
8b332d786fe9.t: Harry mengeluarkan dahak yang tampak seperti slime yang akan kamu lawan di game JRPG—kalau kamu melihat dekat-dekat, kamu hampir bisa melihatnya hidup dan menunggu gilirannya untuk menyerang. Dengan mata menyipit dan bibir mengerucut, Harry merasakan gelombang mual datang dari kejauhan sebagai respons terhadap rasa asin yang busuk itu, tetapi sensasi bisa bernapas dengan bebas mengimbanginya.

8b48bd5ee1bd.en: “Oh, hon! Don’t struggle so much! I’m here for you.” With dull eyes and a downturned smile, the maid looked at Harry’s labored, pained breath, like he had been forced to run a marathon at gunpoint.
8b48bd5ee1bd.t: “Oh, sayang! Jangan terlalu memaksakan diri! Aku di sini untukmu.” Dengan mata redup dan senyum yang menurun, pelayan itu memandangi napas Harry yang berat dan menyakitkan, seolah ia dipaksa lari maraton di bawah todongan senjata.

8c07f5970243.en: “So, that’s him, huh?” Yacamim measured Harry, pouring the leftovers from her shaker into the glass—most of it at least, as she seemed too buzzed to care, or she’s not the type to care about it to begin with. Letting out a single long, wet inwardly burp, she began walking away in a mostly straight line. “No wonder sis whooped his ass.” She tonelessly but loudly spoke to herself on her way out.
8c07f5970243.t: “Jadi, itu dia, ya?” Yacamim menaksir Harry, menuangkan sisa dari shaker-nya ke gelas—setidaknya sebagian besar, karena ia tampak terlalu mabuk untuk peduli, atau memang bukan tipe yang peduli sejak awal. Mengeluarkan satu sendawa panjang yang basah ke dalam, ia mulai berjalan pergi dalam garis yang hampir lurus. “Pantas saja kakak menghajar pantatnya.” Ia berbicara kepada dirinya sendiri dengan datar tetapi keras dalam perjalanannya keluar.

8f2eba6bc625.en: No answer from Yacamim. At least not verbally; a single flip of the bird raised on her hand as she took another sip of her drink, going out of sight.
8f2eba6bc625.t: Tidak ada jawaban dari Yacamim. Setidaknya tidak secara lisan; satu acungan jari tengah terangkat di tangannya saat ia menyesap lagi minumannya, menghilang dari pandangan.

90b037be3df7.en: Yacamim lost her balance, possibly a combination of booze and assuming that this colorful-looking adventurer was a mongoloid beast.
90b037be3df7.t: Yacamim kehilangan keseimbangan, mungkin kombinasi antara minuman keras dan anggapan bahwa petualang yang tampak berwarna-warni ini adalah binatang buas yang dungu.

9172a82be699.en: “During the past days.” The grandmotherly maid spoke from the bathroom, raising her voice above the angry gushing water as she cleaned the phlegm-filled pot.
9172a82be699.t: “Selama beberapa hari terakhir.” Pelayan bak nenek itu berbicara dari kamar mandi, meninggikan suaranya melampaui semburan air yang marah sambil membersihkan pot berisi dahak itu.

920d9c840917.en: Harry could nearly see Itagiba apparating in front of him. I—guess so? A chuckle of his own broke through the ominous feeling stirring in his chest. I have to enjoy this Sanbi-eye thing.
920d9c840917.t: Harry hampir bisa melihat Itagiba muncul di depannya. Aku—kurasa begitu? Kekehannya sendiri menembus perasaan tidak menyenangkan yang bergolak di dadanya. Aku harus menikmati urusan Sanbi-eye ini.

928a9da61f22.en: Harry slowly opened his eyes to the blinding light of a sunny day. His head, then his upper body, felt a gust of humid breeze pass by.
928a9da61f22.t: Harry perlahan membuka matanya pada cahaya menyilaukan hari yang cerah. Kepalanya, lalu tubuh bagian atasnya, merasakan embusan angin lembap lewat.

9352b5b813ca.en: Feeling like he was breathing fire, Harry felt his body shiver as everything came out from up top in a powerful stream that looked like a geyser from a fire hydrant. Amongst the material things being ejected from his body, Harry felt the voidness and loneliness energy within him being purged out as well. Everything was being violently purged—perhaps alcohol is the interface for soul healing, or it is a temporary placebo before the cruel reality resurfaces when sobriety hits.
9352b5b813ca.t: Merasa seolah sedang menyemburkan api, Harry merasakan tubuhnya menggigil saat semuanya keluar dari atas dalam semburan kuat yang tampak seperti geiser dari hidran kebakaran. Di antara benda-benda material yang dikeluarkan dari tubuhnya, Harry merasakan energi kehampaan dan kesepian di dalam dirinya ikut dibersihkan juga. Semuanya dibersihkan dengan keras—mungkin alkohol adalah antarmuka untuk penyembuhan jiwa, atau hanya plasebo sementara sebelum kenyataan kejam muncul kembali saat ia sadar.

95416ecc5eda.en: Harry cackled, raising the glass to cheer. “I never thought it that way!” A rush tickled his insides—or it was his stomach giving a warning.
