95416ecc5eda.t: Harry terkekeh-kekeh, mengangkat gelasnya untuk bersulang. “Aku tidak pernah berpikir begitu!” Sensasi yang menggelitik bagian dalam dirinya—atau itu perutnya yang memberi peringatan.

97117e80a825.en: “YOU’RE NOT A DUDE!” Hiromi blurted out in a panicked voice, for sure getting caught up as to why the room was so tensed up.
97117e80a825.t: “KAU BUKAN COWOK!” seru Hiromi dengan suara panik, jelas mulai paham kenapa ruangan itu begitu tegang.

97b5bfbc6c3f.en: Harry groaned as if he was losing the battle. The groans and gags coming out of his mouth sounded worse than a dreaded cat gag EDM drum beat waking you up in the middle of the night. He didn’t even know where he was anymore as he only felt a constant rush of the atrium scenery spin around him as the vomit was pressuring the back of his throat.
97b5bfbc6c3f.t: Harry mengerang seolah ia kalah dalam pertempuran. Erangan dan bunyi mual yang keluar dari mulutnya terdengar lebih buruk daripada dentuman drum EDM kucing muntah yang mengerikan yang membangunkanmu di tengah malam. Ia bahkan tidak tahu lagi di mana ia berada karena ia hanya merasakan pemandangan atrium yang terus berputar di sekelilingnya sementara muntahan itu menekan bagian belakang tenggorokannya.

9855eb463310.en: “Aiight. Harry, my man, pleased to meet ya!” The massive man stood up and looked down at Harry, not in a threatening manner, but rather literally, as he was almost as tall as a skyscraper. He opened both hands, then raised them high up in the air. Spreading his feet apart to lower his height, he puffed his stomach towards Harry. “Come here, brotha!” It sounded like an ultimatum, not because of the cherry tone but because it was this brute of a man just speaking up.
9855eb463310.t: “Oke. Harry, Bro, senang bertemu denganmu!” Pria raksasa itu berdiri dan memandang Harry dari atas, bukan dengan cara mengancam, melainkan secara harfiah, karena tingginya hampir setinggi gedung pencakar langit. Ia membuka kedua tangannya, lalu mengangkatnya tinggi-tinggi ke udara. Merenggangkan kakinya untuk merendahkan tingginya, ia membusungkan perutnya ke arah Harry. “Sini, Bro!” Kedengarannya seperti ultimatum, bukan karena nadanya yang ceria tetapi karena yang bicara adalah pria bertubuh raksasa ini.

99f4bf784cbe.en: Grabbing two handfuls of metallic darts with colored feathers on the back, Hiromi handed red with blue darts to Harry and kept yellow with white for himself. “You played this before, right?”
99f4bf784cbe.t: Mengambil dua genggam dart logam dengan bulu berwarna di belakangnya, Hiromi menyerahkan dart merah dan biru kepada Harry dan menyimpan yang kuning dan putih untuk dirinya sendiri. “Kau pernah main ini, kan?”

9a7a92d54c2f.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 3: a tavern scene with the mohawked giant, a woman in white and an armored man around a table.
9a7a92d54c2f.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 3: suasana kedai minum dengan raksasa bermohawk, seorang wanita berbaju putih, dan seorang pria berzirah di sekitar meja.

9cc1ea882f18.en: Harry felt this cuddly warmth coming from this beastly humanoid. His breath smelled strongly of ginger, with a tangy tropical twist, while his armpits developed a strong manly musk that would keep many people at bay. However, Harry was too happy to care for that, so he hugged him back just as tightly. “Thanks, Hiromi! Brotha!”
9cc1ea882f18.t: Harry merasakan kehangatan yang nyaman dari humanoid buas ini. Napasnya berbau jahe yang kuat, dengan sentuhan tropis yang asam, sementara ketiaknya mengeluarkan bau musk jantan yang kuat yang akan membuat banyak orang menjauh. Namun, Harry terlalu bahagia untuk memedulikannya, jadi ia membalas pelukannya sama eratnya. “Terima kasih, Hiromi! Bro!”

a140667cac27.en: “So, the door cost one amethyst?” Harry looked towards the pieces of door scattered on the bathroom floor.
a140667cac27.t: “Jadi, pintunya seharga satu amethyst?” Harry memandang ke arah potongan-potongan pintu yang berserakan di lantai kamar mandi.

a17c6329ab28.en: Eiri let go of Harry, firmly holding him by the shoulders, then caressing his head. “That’s PTSD right there! I heard something similar from a friend who cared for an older adventurer too. His whole party got wiped out by a massive walking flathead when they pushed too far into the depths of Bahyum Castle. He would start sobbing uncontrollably out of nowhere, sometimes even trying to kill himself, or get naked and run around screaming from the top of his lungs.” Eiri pointed towards the portrait on the wall of someone who looked awfully close to her. “I bet it is not easy to deal with that, but Mom always said to make life your bitch, not the other way around. Hmmm—so make life your bitch and have it choke on your little thing instead?” A chuckle came out of Eiri as she pinched Harry in the side of his gut.
a17c6329ab28.t: Eiri melepaskan Harry, memegangnya erat di bahu, lalu membelai kepalanya. “Itu PTSD! Aku pernah dengar yang serupa dari seorang teman yang juga merawat seorang petualang tua. Seluruh kelompoknya tewas dibantai walking flathead raksasa saat mereka nekat masuk terlalu jauh ke kedalaman Bahyum Castle. Dia tiba-tiba menangis tak terkendali entah dari mana, kadang bahkan mencoba bunuh diri, atau telanjang dan berlari-lari sambil berteriak sekuat paru-parunya.” Eiri menunjuk potret di dinding seseorang yang tampak sangat mirip dengannya. “Aku yakin tidak mudah menghadapi itu, tapi Ibu selalu bilang buat hidup jadi budakmu, bukan sebaliknya. Hmmm—jadi buat hidup jadi budakmu dan biarkan dia tersedak barang kecilmu saja?” Kekehan keluar dari Eiri sambil mencubit sisi perut Harry.

a26eeef3c631.en: “STAY WITH ME!” screamed Hiromi as he kicked down the bathroom door square in the middle, making a loud boom that sounded like a grenade going off.
a26eeef3c631.t: “TETAP BERSAMAKU!” teriak Hiromi sambil menendang pintu kamar mandi tepat di tengahnya, menimbulkan dentuman keras yang terdengar seperti granat meledak.

a27745b87c90.en: “I can’t bear this anymore.” The maid spoke under her breath, putting her crochet kit back in the thatch bag and pulling out a vial about the size of a shot glass with a cork holding back a black goo filled to the brim. She brought it closer to Harry’s lips, apparently awaiting him to open his mouth. “Please don’t tell anyone about it, hon! Eiri told me to do it without anyone seeing it.”
a27745b87c90.t: “Aku tidak tahan lagi.” Pelayan itu berbisik pelan, memasukkan kembali perlengkapan merajutnya ke tas jerami dan mengeluarkan sebuah botol kecil kira-kira seukuran sloki dengan sumbat gabus yang menahan cairan hitam kental yang terisi sampai penuh. Ia mendekatkannya ke bibir Harry, tampaknya menunggu ia membuka mulutnya. “Tolong jangan bilang siapa-siapa soal ini, sayang! Eiri menyuruhku melakukannya tanpa ada yang melihat.”

a27de040cb15.en: With his mouth open, Harry tried to imagine the scene of two people with bloody flattened noses making out—something about it lacked the amorousness of a kissing scene, although it definitely must have been passionate in its own twisted ways.
a27de040cb15.t: Dengan mulut menganga, Harry mencoba membayangkan adegan dua orang dengan hidung remuk berdarah sedang bercumbu—ada sesuatu yang kurang romantis dibanding adegan ciuman pada umumnya, walaupun pasti penuh gairah dengan caranya sendiri yang menyimpang.

a409a9d6c84e.en: Harry made his way into Sanbi Castle, walking into a familiar mix of a parlor and game room located on the southeast corner. “Maiara?” Harry blurted out, looking at a blurry image of a girl that had to be Maiara—or Itagiba dressed in drag. It was kinda hard to tell.
a409a9d6c84e.t: Harry masuk ke Kastil Sanbi, berjalan ke campuran ruang duduk dan ruang permainan yang familier yang terletak di sudut tenggara. “Maiara?” seru Harry, memandang gambaran buram seorang gadis yang pasti Maiara—atau Itagiba yang berdandan seperti perempuan. Agak sulit dibedakan.

a4649814be73.en: Except, no alarm rang for Harry. This wired feeling slowly dissipated as his memories kept churning in his brain, taking away from the fact that he was somehow still alive despite having a heart attack at some point. Maybe that was the nightmare, and this is my reality? Wait. But then why stuff still feels weird here? Harry looked at his moist eyes and pale face.
a4649814be73.t: Hanya saja, tidak ada alarm yang berbunyi untuk Harry. Perasaan tegang ini perlahan menghilang sementara ingatan-ingatannya terus berputar di otaknya, mengalihkan perhatian dari kenyataan bahwa entah bagaimana ia masih hidup meski pernah terkena serangan jantung suatu saat. Mungkin itu mimpi buruknya, dan inilah kenyataanku? Tunggu. Tapi kalau begitu kenapa banyak hal masih terasa aneh di sini? Harry memandang matanya yang basah dan wajahnya yang pucat.

a8dd7f8472a2.en: Hiromi pushed the handle, stopping the gush of angry water. A relieved sigh came out of him as he patted Harry on the head, shuffling his short black hair. “Harry—my brotha, good job!”
a8dd7f8472a2.t: Hiromi mendorong tuas, menghentikan semburan air yang marah. Helaan napas lega keluar darinya sambil menepuk kepala Harry, mengacak-acak rambut hitam pendeknya. “Harry—Bro-ku, kerja bagus!”

a90f3d019674.en: “Ow, fuck off with that!” Kaiana took a sip of her drink. “You’re the one who introduced him to the team anyways. Do you have someone else that doesn’t suck as much?”
a90f3d019674.t: “Ah, persetan dengan itu!” Kaiana menyesap minumannya. “Lagi pula kau yang memperkenalkannya ke tim. Kau punya orang lain yang tidak separah itu?”

aa14b99f0fc6.en: I didn’t know that, but I guess it makes sense. Somehow the oldest kid rising to the throne feels like something I learned somewhere—but where? School? Did I go to school? Harry meanwhile washed his face in the cold water in the sink when he felt something touching him. It was Hiromi dumping a whole bunch of flakes of something in his hand that melted into soapy bubbles. He brought it closer to his nose, and it smelled like mint. Wasn’t it supposed to be like a bar or something? He scrubbed it on his face, feeling its soapiness aromatically soapy.
aa14b99f0fc6.t: Aku tidak tahu itu, tapi kurasa masuk akal. Entah bagaimana anak tertua yang naik takhta terasa seperti sesuatu yang pernah kupelajari di suatu tempat—tapi di mana? Sekolah? Apa aku pernah sekolah? Harry sementara itu membasuh wajahnya dengan air dingin di wastafel ketika ia merasakan sesuatu menyentuhnya. Itu Hiromi yang menumpahkan banyak sekali serpihan sesuatu ke tangannya yang meleleh menjadi gelembung sabun. Ia mendekatkannya ke hidungnya, dan baunya seperti mint. Bukannya seharusnya berbentuk batangan atau semacamnya? Ia menggosokkannya ke wajahnya, merasakan kesabunannya yang beraroma sabun.

abce0a58d9f7.en: “Go ask her then.” Itanema turned around and returned to the atrium, closing the door behind her. “Bring him with you.”
abce0a58d9f7.t: “Tanyakan saja padanya.” Itanema berbalik dan kembali ke atrium, menutup pintu di belakangnya. “Bawa dia bersamamu.”

ac18cec1dca3.en: “Snipe all territories? That’s—different—I think.” Harry adjusted his pants, feeling his privates glued to his inner thigh, nearly falling backward as he performed such simple task. “Can—can you explain?” Harry released a wet burp that sounded dangerously close to being upgraded into a puke.
ac18cec1dca3.t: “Menembak semua wilayah? Itu—beda—kurasa.” Harry membetulkan celananya, merasakan kemaluannya menempel di paha bagian dalam, hampir jatuh ke belakang saat melakukan tugas sesederhana itu. “Bisa—bisa kau jelaskan?” Harry mengeluarkan sendawa basah yang terdengar sangat dekat untuk naik pangkat menjadi muntahan.

aca7e02d4ce2.en: Carefully pouring the rest of the black honey into Harry’s mouth, the maid went to the bathroom to clean away the vial. A familiar gush of angry water sounded from the bathroom when she pulled the handle above the sink.
aca7e02d4ce2.t: Dengan hati-hati menuangkan sisa madu hitam ke mulut Harry, pelayan itu pergi ke kamar mandi untuk membersihkan botol kecil itu. Semburan air marah yang familier terdengar dari kamar mandi saat ia menarik tuas di atas wastafel.

ad2fc975681b.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 1: a woman in a red hat and black dress sits knitting beside Harry, who lies shirtless in bed.
ad2fc975681b.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 1: seorang wanita bertopi merah dan bergaun hitam duduk merajut di samping Harry, yang berbaring bertelanjang dada di ranjang.

ada417191285.en: Eiri played with her quill as she stared back at blank Harry. “You know, that’s pretty ballsy coming to the king-maid’s office and then flat out ignoring me.” Eiri kept on looking as Harry’s expression seemed stuck in time. “You okay, Harry?”
ada417191285.t: Eiri memainkan pena bulunya sambil menatap balik Harry yang kosong. “Tahu tidak, berani juga kamu datang ke kantor king-maid lalu terang-terangan mengabaikanku.” Eiri terus memandang sementara raut wajah Harry tampak terhenti dalam waktu. “Kamu baik-baik saja, Harry?”

b205be12f256.en: “SO YOU’RE GOING TO LEAVE JUST LIKE THAT?” Kaiana angrily shouted at Takeo, who was walking out of the bar with determination in his step and not even a glint of wanting to look back.
b205be12f256.t: “JADI KAU MAU PERGI BEGITU SAJA?” Kaiana berteriak marah kepada Takeo, yang berjalan keluar dari bar dengan langkah mantap dan bahkan tanpa secercah keinginan untuk menoleh.

b302b02524ca.en: “You’re welcome!” Aurora remained standing up, now looking at the clothes laid out by Harry. “Honey, do you need any help with that? You don’t need to bathe; I did that last night.”
b302b02524ca.t: “Sama-sama!” Aurora tetap berdiri, kini memandang pakaian yang diletakkan di samping Harry. “Sayang, perlu bantuan memakainya? Kamu tidak perlu mandi; aku sudah memandikanmu semalam.”

b3adb798f011.en: “Hold a hunk, brotha!” Hiromi opened the leather bag, pulled out a single amethyst crusted in golden metal, and handed it to Harry.
b3adb798f011.t: “Tunggu sebentar, Bro!” Hiromi membuka kantong kulit itu, mengeluarkan sebuah amethyst tunggal yang dibalut logam emas, dan menyerahkannya kepada Harry.

b3c0542c9303.en: Hiromi threw a four-punch streak with all his might, but Yacamim kept evading and blocking everything. “I’m too drunk for this!” He defended two sloppy punches, and then a solid kick from Yacamim that took away his breath. “Fu—” He couldn’t even curse as he felt his chest muscles tearing under the skin. Redoing the same punch streak again, but on the last punch, he faked it out, then threw a forward kick with all his might, probably to show her off his own lower body strength.
b3c0542c9303.t: Hiromi melepaskan rentetan empat pukulan dengan sekuat tenaga, tetapi Yacamim terus menghindari dan menangkis semuanya. “Aku terlalu mabuk untuk ini!” Ia menangkis dua pukulan asal-asalan, lalu tendangan mantap dari Yacamim yang membuatnya kehabisan napas. “Bang—” Ia bahkan tidak bisa mengumpat karena merasakan otot-otot dadanya robek di bawah kulit. Mengulangi rentetan pukulan yang sama lagi, tetapi pada pukulan terakhir, ia mengecoh, lalu melepaskan tendangan depan dengan sekuat tenaga, mungkin untuk memamerkan kekuatan tubuh bagian bawahnya sendiri.

b46044efcbe4.en: “We’re in this together, but you gotta tell me!” Eiri let go of Harry’s shoulder and rested her weight against the table, crossing her arm as her perked-up ears looked to be hanging at every word of his babbling.
b46044efcbe4.t: “Kita menghadapi ini bersama, tapi kamu harus memberitahuku!” Eiri melepaskan bahu Harry dan menyandarkan berat badannya ke meja, menyilangkan lengannya sementara telinganya yang menegak tampak menyimak setiap kata dari ocehannya.

b5ca149a3c2c.en: In the back of his mind, a thought rushed by. Perhaps this whole thing was nothing but a vivid bullshit nightmare fueled by several sleepless nights of working in a meaningless cubicle job that he compensated with binge eating like a hog. He must still be plopping his big fat ass on the same old fart-soaked recliner with beer on one side and tacos on the other. C’mon! Just wake me up already! I wanna go home!
b5ca149a3c2c.t: Di sudut benaknya, sebuah pikiran melintas. Mungkin semua ini hanyalah mimpi buruk omong kosong yang begitu nyata, yang dipicu beberapa malam tanpa tidur bekerja di pekerjaan bilik kerja yang tak berarti yang ia imbangi dengan makan berlebihan seperti babi. Ia pasti masih menaruh pantat gendutnya yang besar di kursi malas tua yang sama yang penuh bau kentut, dengan bir di satu sisi dan taco di sisi lain. Ayolah! Bangunkan aku saja! Aku mau pulang!

b8172e764bf0.en: Bursting out laughing, Hiromi almost choked on his drink as well, seeing Harry looking like he had just drunk gasoline. “I think I did it a bit too strong—oh well, you will get used to it. By the way, have you been told the story of how I met her?” He pointed towards the door to the atrium, where Yacamim was long gone.
b8172e764bf0.t: Tertawa terbahak-bahak, Hiromi juga hampir tersedak minumannya, melihat Harry tampak seperti baru meminum bensin. “Kurasa aku membuatnya agak terlalu keras—ya sudahlah, nanti kau terbiasa. Ngomong-ngomong, kau sudah pernah diceritakan bagaimana aku bertemu dengannya?” Ia menunjuk ke arah pintu ke atrium, tempat Yacamim sudah lama pergi.

b861bb368fba.en: “Hehehe. Go figure.” The Darfaries adventurer raised his deep voice towards the open door where Yacamim had just walked through. “Hey yo! Monnahigh at Shaved Bagarisa?”
b861bb368fba.t: “Hehehe. Sudah kuduga.” Petualang Darfaries itu meninggikan suaranya yang berat ke arah pintu terbuka yang baru saja dilewati Yacamim. “Hei yo! Monnahigh di Shaved Bagarisa?”

bd69e93c0563.en: Harry felt a familiar sweet honey smell from the black goo hit the back of his nose with such intensity that it was repugnant. His empty stomach curled up, forcing him to dry-heave like some cats do when smelling cheese or sour cream.
bd69e93c0563.t: Harry mencium bau madu manis yang familier dari cairan hitam kental itu yang menghantam bagian belakang hidungnya dengan intensitas sebegitu kuat sampai menjijikkan. Perutnya yang kosong bergulung, memaksanya muntah kering seperti beberapa kucing saat mencium keju atau krim asam.

bda1ede24b5c.en: “Spare the deets. I got the gist from Itagiba.” This brute pointed towards the door. “Her sister went overboard like usual.”
bda1ede24b5c.t: “Tidak usah detailnya. Aku sudah dengar garis besarnya dari Itagiba.” Pria kekar ini menunjuk ke arah pintu. “Kakaknya kelewatan seperti biasa.”

c00e22633639.en: “No—wait. I actually need to go talk with Eiri first!” Harry pointed towards the still half-open door Yacamim had left through to the atrium, remembering the royal offices were upstairs.
c00e22633639.t: “Tidak—tunggu. Sebenarnya aku harus bicara dengan Eiri dulu!” Harry menunjuk ke arah pintu yang masih setengah terbuka tempat Yacamim keluar ke atrium, teringat bahwa kantor-kantor kerajaan ada di lantai atas.

c07428bd4398.en: With a rumble, Harry’s stomach groaned over his full bladder, still pressuring him. Picking up the cookie from the thatch box, he looked at the maid’s caramel eyes. “Thank you—ahh—” His mind drew blank, not because he forgot her name, but surely never heard it in the first place.
c07428bd4398.t: Dengan gemuruh, perut Harry mengerang melampaui kandung kemihnya yang penuh, yang masih menekannya. Mengambil kue itu dari kotak jerami, ia memandang mata karamel pelayan itu. “Terima kasih—ahh—” Pikirannya kosong, bukan karena ia lupa namanya, tetapi jelas karena ia belum pernah mendengarnya sejak awal.

c091da4331d9.en: Eiri sighed as the shine in her eyes faded. “It couldn’t have happened within the castle grounds. There are always guards at the main entrance, and my maids are handpicked and vigilant—for all we know, the memory seems so vague that it could have been a guy. I’m sorry, Harry, I am! But all I can say at this point is to have you keep trying to dig through your memories. They must have injected some nasty stuff to scramble your brain, but if you get me any specific details, then I can help you by opening a missing person search quest! That way, we can gather hints of someone who crossed paths with you without accusing anyone!” Eiri gave Harry a motherly hug. “Not that I don’t want to bring justice to whoever did this to you, but we can only accuse someone if we have proof. Or we’re the ones who will be punished.”
c091da4331d9.t: Eiri menghela napas sementara kilau di matanya memudar. “Tidak mungkin itu terjadi di dalam lingkungan kastil. Selalu ada pengawal di pintu masuk utama, dan pelayan-pelayanku dipilih sendiri dan waspada—sejauh yang kita tahu, ingatannya tampak begitu samar sehingga bisa saja itu seorang pria. Maaf, Harry, sungguh! Tapi yang bisa kukatakan saat ini hanyalah agar kamu terus mencoba menggali ingatanmu. Mereka pasti menyuntikkan sesuatu yang parah untuk mengacak-acak otakmu, tapi kalau kamu bisa memberiku detail spesifik apa pun, aku bisa membantumu dengan membuka misi pencarian orang hilang! Dengan begitu, kita bisa mengumpulkan petunjuk tentang seseorang yang pernah bersinggungan denganmu tanpa menuduh siapa pun!” Eiri memeluk Harry dengan pelukan keibuan. “Bukan berarti aku tidak mau menegakkan keadilan bagi siapa pun yang melakukan ini padamu, tapi kita hanya bisa menuduh seseorang kalau kita punya bukti. Atau kitalah yang akan dihukum.”

c0c97fa51a6a.en: “Days? But—but I fought Maiara this morning!” Harry placed his feet on the cold wooden floor and peeked towards the open window, seeing a sunny day shine down in the lively city. “Ahh—right?”
c0c97fa51a6a.t: “Hari? Tapi—tapi aku melawan Maiara tadi pagi!” Harry menapakkan kakinya di lantai kayu yang dingin dan mengintip ke arah jendela yang terbuka, melihat hari yang cerah menyinari kota yang hidup. “Ahh—kan?”

c2a491facc72.en: “Ahhh—hi!” Harry froze up, seeing this ridiculously buffed man, even more so than Itagiba, standing in a weird pose, asking Harry to come at him. “Ehh—I’m sorry, but—I need to go see Eiri.”
c2a491facc72.t: “Ahhh—hai!” Harry membeku, melihat pria yang luar biasa kekar ini, bahkan lebih kekar daripada Itagiba, berdiri dalam pose aneh, menyuruh Harry mendekatinya. “Ehh—maaf, tapi—aku harus menemui Eiri.”

c2e17afac07c.en: “No! I got this!” Hiromi placed one hand at the table’s end, swiping the booze-soaked sliced lolish off the table and into his hand. He squeezed the excess back into the table and plopped the sliced lolish into both drinks. With a triumphant smile, he wiped his hands on his armor. “Aiight! Let’s go!”
c2e17afac07c.t: “Tidak! Aku bisa!” Hiromi meletakkan satu tangan di ujung meja, menyapu irisan lolish yang basah oleh minuman keras dari meja ke tangannya. Ia memeras kelebihannya kembali ke meja dan menjatuhkan irisan lolish itu ke kedua minuman. Dengan senyum kemenangan, ia menyeka tangannya di baju zirahnya. “Oke! Ayo!”

c4024e0fec07.en: Trying to get caught up, Harry began throwing darts too, but it looked like he sprayed dartboard repellant on them as most were clicking off the board or the nearby walls. With each dart throw, Harry was slowing down. His face was growing paler, strained. One of his last darts clung tightly against a sizeable orange section in the board, giving him a rushing feeling, or the rushing sensation was from his stomach rumbling as it began its final preparations before pressing the nuclear button. Throwing the last dart as he breathed heavily, the room started to move too much. He clashed against Hiromi as he lost his balance.
c4024e0fec07.t: Mencoba mengejar, Harry juga mulai melempar dart, tetapi tampaknya ia menyemprotkan pengusir papan dart ke dart-dartnya karena sebagian besar berdetak lepas dari papan atau dinding di dekatnya. Di setiap lemparan dart, Harry semakin melambat. Wajahnya semakin pucat, tegang. Salah satu dart terakhirnya menempel erat di bagian jingga yang cukup besar di papan, memberinya sensasi yang melonjak, atau sensasi melonjak itu dari perutnya yang bergemuruh saat mulai melakukan persiapan akhir sebelum menekan tombol nuklir. Melempar dart terakhir sambil bernapas berat, ruangan mulai bergerak terlalu banyak. Ia menabrak Hiromi saat kehilangan keseimbangan.

c51dbcafb0f9.en: The grandmotherly maid glanced over quietly, still crocheting away.
c51dbcafb0f9.t: Pelayan bak nenek itu melirik diam-diam, masih terus merajut.

c6802e6f9f65.en: The excessive crunchiness of the finger cake was scraping the roof of Harry’s mouth. That was at least until his teeth dug into its center, giving away a moist filling with red chunks inside. Like orange yet tarter, a sweet, tangy taste contrasted the crunchy outer outside. It was so good that Harry closed his eyes and clicked his tongue, chowing it down with a loud humming—like a kitten tasting meat for the first time. As he kept chewing it, the red chunks grabbed all the attention by releasing a crisp apple-like flavor into the mix. Within three bites, the cake became one with Harry. “Hmmm—this is really tasty! Thank you, Aurora!”
c6802e6f9f65.t: Kue jari yang terlalu renyah itu menggores langit-langit mulut Harry. Setidaknya sampai giginya menembus bagian tengahnya, memperlihatkan isian lembap dengan potongan-potongan merah di dalamnya. Seperti jeruk namun lebih asam, rasa manis dan segar itu kontras dengan bagian luar yang renyah. Begitu enaknya sampai Harry memejamkan mata dan mendecakkan lidahnya, melahapnya dengan gumaman keras—seperti anak kucing yang mencicipi daging untuk pertama kalinya. Saat ia terus mengunyahnya, potongan-potongan merah itu merebut semua perhatian dengan melepaskan rasa renyah seperti apel ke dalam campuran itu. Dalam tiga gigitan, kue itu menyatu dengan Harry. “Hmmm—ini enak sekali! Terima kasih, Aurora!”

c7cb9b1e1c04.en: By himself now, Harry could only hear Aurora’s footsteps slowly clacking on the stairs while the familiar rustles of the city and gusts of humid salty wind rushed into the window. “Wait—these clothes are different.” The clothes Aurora laid on the bed beside him didn’t look as fancy as his previous clothes. They had a brownish base color, with Sanbi blue scales as accents. This looks like a company logo? On the right side of the shirt, there was also a Sanbi fish drawing sewn into the clothing. Oh shit! I really need to pee. Harry let go of the shirt and walked stiffly towards the bathroom. His bladder somehow made this issue even more urgent the closer he was to the oddly square toilet.
c7cb9b1e1c04.t: Kini sendirian, Harry hanya bisa mendengar langkah kaki Aurora perlahan berketuk di tangga sementara desir kota yang familier dan embusan angin asin yang lembap menerobos masuk ke jendela. “Tunggu—pakaian ini berbeda.” Pakaian yang diletakkan Aurora di ranjang di sampingnya tidak tampak semewah pakaiannya sebelumnya. Warna dasarnya kecokelatan, dengan sisik biru Sanbi sebagai aksen. Ini kelihatan seperti logo perusahaan? Di sisi kanan kemeja, ada juga gambar ikan Sanbi yang dijahitkan ke pakaian itu. Oh sial! Aku benar-benar harus kencing. Harry melepaskan kemeja itu dan berjalan kaku menuju kamar mandi. Kandung kemihnya entah bagaimana membuat urusan ini semakin mendesak semakin dekat ia ke kloset yang anehnya persegi itu.

c99ed2961c48.en: As if this kind of event was not uncommon, people started to rustle around, forming an impromptu battleground by pushing tables away and creating a battlefield in the middle of the bar.
c99ed2961c48.t: Seolah kejadian semacam ini bukan hal yang aneh, orang-orang mulai bergerak, membentuk arena pertarungan dadakan dengan mendorong meja-meja menjauh dan menciptakan medan pertempuran di tengah bar.

caaf70bef125.en: Kaiana and Hiromi smiled at each other as they finished the ritualistic Darfaries hug, then Kaiana jumped out of the chair and waved goodbye as she walked out of the door.
caaf70bef125.t: Kaiana dan Hiromi saling tersenyum saat mereka menyelesaikan pelukan ritual Darfaries itu, lalu Kaiana melompat turun dari kursi dan melambai pamit sambil berjalan keluar pintu.

cacc1e317bfe.en: “But—Sora. I have—to go! I need—to tell—Eiri!” The words barely came out in between his breaths. His dilated pupils looked at the maid with all the remaining will he could muster, as the vision of being suffocated by a girly figure was prominent in his mind.
cacc1e317bfe.t: “Tapi—Sora. Aku harus—pergi! Aku harus—memberi tahu—Eiri!” Kata-kata itu nyaris tak keluar di sela-sela napasnya. Pupil matanya yang membesar memandang pelayan itu dengan seluruh sisa tekad yang bisa ia kerahkan, sementara bayangan dicekik oleh sosok feminin menonjol di benaknya.

cb1746e35bf4.en: Hiromi let out a long hum as his eyes seemed to long for her already. “After we used Body Restore on each other, we went back to her room.” Hiromi let out a smirk, seemingly just talking aloud to himself. “I still remember pulling that awesome blackish-purple hair like it was yesterday. I just couldn’t stop cumming—”
cb1746e35bf4.t: Hiromi bergumam panjang sementara matanya tampak sudah merindukan Yacamim. “Setelah kami saling memakai Body Restore, kami kembali ke kamarnya.” Hiromi menyeringai, tampaknya hanya berbicara keras kepada dirinya sendiri. “Aku masih ingat menjambak rambut ungu kehitaman yang keren itu seolah baru kemarin. Aku tidak bisa berhenti ngecrot—”

cc45b578ef1e.en: “I—this dream I had—I thought it was a dream, but now I remember more—I think—” Harry glanced at Eiri, his voice growing weaker.
cc45b578ef1e.t: “Aku—mimpi yang kualami ini—kukira itu mimpi, tapi sekarang aku ingat lebih banyak—kurasa—” Harry melirik Eiri, suaranya semakin lemah.

cd3e122359df.en: “You fought Maiara on the morning of Paulin fifteenth. Today is the seventeenth, close to Sunnohigh right now.” The maid returned from the bathroom and hid away the vial deep in her crochet kit with a victorious smile on her face—if one were to guess, it’s not every day a lovely old grandmother goes against the rules. “I’m really sorry, honey, but when you lose that much weight that quickly, you will feel funny for a bit. King-maid told me that the queen’s order was because of the Sanbi-eye job.”
cd3e122359df.t: “Kamu melawan Maiara pada pagi tanggal lima belas Paulin. Hari ini tanggal tujuh belas, sekarang hampir Sunnohigh.” Pelayan itu kembali dari kamar mandi dan menyembunyikan botol kecil itu jauh di dalam perlengkapan merajutnya dengan senyum kemenangan di wajahnya—kalau boleh menebak, tidak setiap hari seorang nenek tua yang manis melanggar aturan. “Aku sungguh minta maaf, sayang, tapi kalau berat badanmu turun sebanyak itu secepat itu, kamu akan merasa aneh sebentar. King-maid bilang perintah ratu itu karena pekerjaan Sanbi-eye.”

cec387f7cdcf.en: Meanwhile, the bar was completely lit up! The verbal bets and cheering in the background filled the room with noise and excitement. “Go, Yacamim! Go Yacamim! Represent Sanbi!” The room blew up even more when she began to stand up, regaining her foothold and tightening her fists in her version strength display.
cec387f7cdcf.t: Sementara itu, bar itu benar-benar meledak riuh! Taruhan lisan dan sorakan di latar belakang memenuhi ruangan dengan kebisingan dan kegembiraan. “Ayo, Yacamim! Ayo Yacamim! Wakili Sanbi!” Ruangan semakin meledak ketika ia mulai berdiri, mendapatkan kembali pijakannya dan mengepalkan tinjunya dalam versinya sendiri dari pamer kekuatan.

d3b29586c738.en: “You’re welcome, hon! In that case, I’m going to go ahead and let King-maid Eiri know you’re awake. Take your time.” The maid gave another big smile as she picked up her crochet bag and left the room, closing the door carefully to avoid making too much noise.
d3b29586c738.t: “Sama-sama, sayang! Kalau begitu, aku akan memberi tahu King-maid Eiri bahwa kamu sudah bangun. Pelan-pelan saja.” Pelayan itu memberikan senyum lebar lagi sambil mengambil tas rajutannya dan meninggalkan ruangan, menutup pintu dengan hati-hati agar tidak terlalu berisik.

d3ceaa518ec1.en: Clearing his throat, Hiromi seemed to have caught up to what he had just said. His big hands swiped the excess drink off his chitin armor as he laughed it off. “They might look alike, but they are pretty different after all. If it was Maiara, I bet that would have never happened—there you go. That was the grand tale, but hey, at least you can still suck on the kingdom’s tits with an easy job!” Hiromi brought his nearly-empty jar closer to Harry with a bright smile that even made his large tusks shine.
d3ceaa518ec1.t: Berdeham, Hiromi tampaknya baru menyadari apa yang baru saja ia katakan. Tangannya yang besar menyapu kelebihan minuman dari baju zirah kitinnya sambil tertawa santai. “Mereka mungkin mirip, tapi ternyata cukup berbeda. Kalau itu Maiara, aku yakin itu tidak akan pernah terjadi—nah, begitu. Itulah kisah besarnya, tapi hei, setidaknya kau masih bisa menyusu pada kerajaan dengan pekerjaan yang gampang!” Hiromi mendekatkan toplesnya yang hampir kosong ke Harry dengan senyum cerah yang bahkan membuat taringnya yang besar berkilau.

d46172e291ef.en: “I’ve been working on this one for a while. Glad it worked!” Eiri smiled cheerfully. “Now, are you ready? How’s your stomach feeling? Do you need anything to eat?” Eiri checked Harry’s new uniform out. “Actually, since you shared your secret, I will share mine too. You look better with less weight, but I still don’t agree with the monarchy’s department, or rather Neferteri’s decision.”
d46172e291ef.t: “Aku sudah lama melatih yang ini. Senang berhasil!” Eiri tersenyum ceria. “Sekarang, sudah siap? Bagaimana perutmu? Perlu makan sesuatu?” Eiri memeriksa seragam baru Harry. “Sebenarnya, karena kamu sudah membagi rahasiamu, aku juga akan membagi rahasiaku. Kamu terlihat lebih baik dengan berat badan yang lebih sedikit, tapi aku tetap tidak setuju dengan departemen monarki, atau lebih tepatnya keputusan Neferteri.”

d4b6cd204a56.en: “Yo! So, I guess you’re the Harry guy?” A stronger-willed gruff voice of intense bass came out of the scary-looking large humanoid sitting at the bar by Yacamim. It was a Darfaries, a humanoid species known for its large size with girthy tusks, floppy ears, and a nerve resembling a varicose vein that pops up from the tip of the middle and ring fingers and travels through the back and down the other hand.
d4b6cd204a56.t: “Yo! Jadi, kurasa kau si Harry itu?” Suara serak yang lebih berkemauan keras dengan bas yang dalam keluar dari humanoid besar yang tampak menakutkan yang duduk di bar di dekat Yacamim. Ia seorang Darfaries, spesies humanoid yang dikenal karena ukurannya yang besar dengan taring tebal, telinga terkulai, dan saraf mirip varises yang menonjol dari ujung jari tengah dan jari manis lalu menjalar melewati punggung dan turun ke tangan yang lain.

d57880db8482.en: Another gagging sound came out of Harry as he held his mouth. Whatever he clashed into gave a nick on his forehead, and he started bleeding.
d57880db8482.t: Bunyi mual lagi keluar dari Harry saat ia menutup mulutnya. Apa pun yang ia tabrak meninggalkan luka gores di dahinya, dan ia mulai berdarah.

d6dce634a3c4.en: “HIROMI HIGH-GANDEW TOUGH-HAMMER!” Hiromi said in a powerful, deep voice, echoing in the bar loudly enough to be far above the chatter. The Darfaries folks amongst the crowd, who were few and far between compared to other races, seemed to almost in unison raise their mug towards them—like a sort of acknowledgment. Meanwhile, most of the others present didn’t seem to give two shits.
d6dce634a3c4.t: “HIROMI HIGH-GANDEW TOUGH-HAMMER!” kata Hiromi dengan suara yang kuat dan berat, menggema di bar cukup keras hingga jauh melampaui obrolan. Orang-orang Darfaries di antara kerumunan, yang jumlahnya sedikit dan jarang dibandingkan ras-ras lain, tampaknya hampir serempak mengangkat gelas mereka ke arah mereka—seperti semacam pengakuan. Sementara itu, sebagian besar orang lain yang hadir tampaknya sama sekali tidak peduli.

d7fece0fb0eb.en: Harry touched his stomach; it felt a bit tender and very empty. “It felt really weird at first, but I think I’m getting used to it. Actually, I’m not sure if I am that hungry at the moment. I think I drank too much.”
d7fece0fb0eb.t: Harry menyentuh perutnya; terasa agak nyeri dan sangat kosong. “Awalnya rasanya aneh sekali, tapi kurasa aku mulai terbiasa. Sebenarnya, aku tidak yakin aku selapar itu saat ini. Kurasa aku minum terlalu banyak.”

d9189d45d246.en: Apparently, the massive Darfaries man quickly didn’t seem to take kindly to being left hanging; at least one could tell by his souring face as he kept on holding the pose. Somehow, his large tusks now looked quite pointy and threatening. “No shit! You really don’t know about the Darfaires handshake?” Pure disbelief coursed through his voice as his large eyes stared Harry down—like a guy trying to pick a fight with you at a bar.
d9189d45d246.t: Tampaknya, pria Darfaries raksasa itu dengan cepat tidak senang dibiarkan menggantung; setidaknya bisa dilihat dari wajahnya yang semakin masam saat ia terus menahan pose itu. Entah bagaimana, taringnya yang besar kini tampak cukup runcing dan mengancam. “Yang benar saja! Kau benar-benar tidak tahu soal jabat tangan Darfaires?” Ketidakpercayaan murni mengalir dalam suaranya sementara matanya yang besar menatap Harry tajam—seperti pria yang mencoba mengajakmu berkelahi di bar.

da1d4328e062.en: Harry was mesmerized by the familiar blurry ceiling as the gush of water filled the background, louder than the noises from the city and birds chirping outside. A natural radiance of energy began to spread from his throat into his guts and outwardly into his body. Harry felt like someone had just transplanted his brain into a new body full of energy—the same energy you get when you wake up late in the morning without an alarm clock on the weekend and have a hearty breakfast with an excellent export-grade roast coffee. With a coughing fit, as he sat up in bed, Harry cleared his lung and felt the leftover sweet taste of the black honey taste mix with a salty, foul taste of the phlegm that was nearly choking him before.
da1d4328e062.t: Harry terpesona oleh langit-langit buram yang familier sementara semburan air memenuhi latar, lebih keras daripada kebisingan kota dan kicau burung di luar. Pancaran energi alami mulai menyebar dari tenggorokannya ke perutnya dan keluar ke seluruh tubuhnya. Harry merasa seolah seseorang baru saja memindahkan otaknya ke tubuh baru yang penuh energi—energi yang sama yang kamu rasakan saat bangun siang tanpa alarm di akhir pekan lalu sarapan lezat dengan kopi sangrai kualitas ekspor yang luar biasa. Dengan serangan batuk, saat ia duduk di ranjang, Harry melegakan paru-parunya dan merasakan sisa rasa manis madu hitam bercampur dengan rasa asin dan busuk dahak yang tadi hampir mencekiknya.

daf08b8cd71d.en: Kaiana pulled a chair, then stood on it—perhaps she was aware enough of their height differences that, without a chair, her head would be awfully close to Hiromi’s junk when they touched bodies. Matching Hiromi’s pose, she got face-to-face with him. “KAIANA DELTACROSS!” She shouted in the bar, catching everyone’s attention as her breasts got squished against Hiromi’s armor.
daf08b8cd71d.t: Kaiana menarik sebuah kursi, lalu berdiri di atasnya—mungkin ia cukup sadar akan perbedaan tinggi mereka sehingga, tanpa kursi, kepalanya akan sangat dekat dengan anu Hiromi saat tubuh mereka bersentuhan. Menyamai pose Hiromi, ia berhadapan muka dengannya. “KAIANA DELTACROSS!” Ia berteriak di bar, menarik perhatian semua orang saat payudaranya tertekan ke baju zirah Hiromi.

db3053cb424f.en: Looking down like a puppy caught chewing on sandals, Harry showed the amethyst ball again to Eiri. “Hiromi told—told that I should just—enjoy life a bit. I had a bit much and—almost puked in the parlor. He brought me to the bathroom, but he broke the door.” Harry gave the amethyst ball to Eiri. “He gave me this to pay for it—I’m sorry.”
db3053cb424f.t: Menunduk seperti anak anjing yang ketahuan mengunyah sandal, Harry menunjukkan bola amethyst itu lagi kepada Eiri. “Hiromi bilang—bilang aku harus—menikmati hidup sedikit. Aku minum agak kebanyakan dan—hampir muntah di ruang duduk. Dia membawaku ke kamar mandi, tapi dia merusak pintunya.” Harry memberikan bola amethyst itu kepada Eiri. “Dia memberiku ini untuk membayarnya—maaf.”

dc7b3e8a08f6.en: Harry kept looking, assuming Hiromi would abuse the slicer like he did the muddler, maybe even break it in half. However, he didn’t seem to apply all his pent-up anger to it. Instead, he moved the root on the slicer with good enough precision to avoid slicing his giant hands in the process, making several slices of lolish root, some thin, some not so thin. The slices were being plumped on the table. When he was done, he waved the slicer in the air to dry it, letting juices drip all over, before shoving it back on the cabinet below—perhaps the real reason this mandoline slicer was fucked up wasn’t age after all, but abuse by certain functioning alcoholics.
dc7b3e8a08f6.t: Harry terus memandang, mengira Hiromi akan menyiksa pengiris itu seperti ia menyiksa penumbuk tadi, mungkin bahkan mematahkannya menjadi dua. Namun, ia tampaknya tidak melampiaskan semua amarahnya yang terpendam padanya. Sebaliknya, ia menggerakkan akar itu di atas pengiris dengan presisi yang cukup untuk menghindari mengiris tangannya yang raksasa dalam prosesnya, membuat beberapa irisan akar lolish, ada yang tipis, ada yang tidak terlalu tipis. Irisan-irisan itu berjatuhan di meja. Setelah selesai, ia mengayunkan pengiris itu di udara untuk mengeringkannya, membiarkan cairan menetes ke mana-mana, sebelum menjejalkannya kembali ke lemari di bawah—mungkin alasan sebenarnya pengiris mandolin ini rusak parah bukanlah usia, melainkan penyiksaan oleh pecandu alkohol yang masih berfungsi tertentu.

de1bb3113476.en: “I’m sorry, honey. I know it’s strong, but you will feel much better.” Her eyes shone with the worry of a grandmother who is told she can’t feed her grandkids whatever she wants to. “King-maid told me I couldn’t bring you back to how you looked before because it was an order from the queen. I’m truly sorry, hon—I can only give you this much black honey.”
de1bb3113476.t: “Maaf, sayang. Aku tahu baunya kuat, tapi kamu akan merasa jauh lebih baik.” Matanya bersinar dengan kecemasan seorang nenek yang dilarang memberi makan cucu-cucunya apa pun yang ia mau. “King-maid bilang aku tidak boleh mengembalikanmu ke penampilanmu sebelumnya karena itu perintah ratu. Aku sungguh minta maaf, sayang—aku hanya bisa memberimu madu hitam sebanyak ini.”

de280bcdc64d.en: The bar chatter quickly died down, as if everyone’s mother was insulted simultaneously. A tense atmosphere took over the place as if a grand jury were about to state their verdict to the defendant.
de280bcdc64d.t: Obrolan di bar cepat mereda, seolah ibu semua orang dihina pada saat yang bersamaan. Suasana tegang mengambil alih tempat itu seolah dewan juri agung akan menyampaikan putusannya kepada terdakwa.

e112670ad7c2.en: Harry slowly opened his eyes to the blinding light of a sunny day. His head, then his upper body, felt a gust of humid breeze pass by. His nose picked up a familiar salty with a slightly fishy smell filling up the room; it kinda smelled like home. His body felt tender, somewhat warm too. Not only from the sun tickling his skin but from within as well—like that funky feeling somewhere between dull pain and fever you get when going to bed after spending all day playing on a sunny beach, getting wasted on cheap beer while gorging on seafood.
e112670ad7c2.t: Harry perlahan membuka matanya pada cahaya menyilaukan hari yang cerah. Kepalanya, lalu tubuh bagian atasnya, merasakan embusan angin lembap lewat. Hidungnya menangkap bau asin yang familier dengan sedikit amis yang memenuhi ruangan; baunya agak seperti rumah. Tubuhnya terasa nyeri, agak hangat juga. Bukan hanya dari matahari yang menggelitik kulitnya tetapi juga dari dalam—seperti perasaan aneh di antara nyeri tumpul dan demam yang kamu rasakan saat tidur setelah seharian bermain di pantai yang cerah, mabuk berat dengan bir murah sambil melahap hidangan laut.

e20fc2706992.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 4: Harry drinks from a big mug while the laughing mohawked giant and a dark-haired woman look on.
e20fc2706992.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 4: Harry minum dari gelas besar sementara raksasa bermohawk yang tertawa dan seorang wanita berambut gelap memperhatikan.

e398556a0eda.en: “Aiight!” Hiromi threw a dart at the board, but it clung and fell to the ground. “Just a hunk—that was me warming up!” He threw another, and it landed miraculously on a green section close to the center. “Now try to throw on a green section or anywhere else.”
e398556a0eda.t: “Oke!” Hiromi melempar sebatang dart ke papan, tetapi dart itu menempel lalu jatuh ke lantai. “Cuma sebentar—tadi aku pemanasan!” Ia melempar satu lagi, dan secara ajaib dart itu mendarat di bagian hijau dekat tengah. “Sekarang coba lempar ke bagian hijau atau di mana saja.”

e40500ca3fc3.en: Helping Harry towards the sink, Hiromi glanced back at Arukia with narrow eyes and a sulking face that made his tusks look even more threatening. “I made the job easier for you, or did you want to clean puke off the floor?” His pointed voice sounded like an actual ultimatum this time.
e40500ca3fc3.t: Membantu Harry ke wastafel, Hiromi kembali melirik Arukia dengan mata menyipit dan wajah merajuk yang membuat taringnya tampak semakin mengancam. “Aku membuat pekerjaanmu lebih mudah, atau kau mau membersihkan muntahan dari lantai?” Suaranya yang tajam kali ini terdengar seperti ultimatum sungguhan.

e41c6263b1db.en: Like a rabbit fleeing a wolf, Sora jumped out of her chair and exited the room so quickly that it felt like she had superhuman or, more specifically, super-wozefaries capabilities.
e41c6263b1db.t: Seperti kelinci yang kabur dari serigala, Sora melompat dari kursinya dan keluar ruangan begitu cepat sampai terasa seolah ia punya kemampuan manusia super atau, lebih tepatnya, wozefaries super.

e55bb1765c1f.en: Harry’s ears rang. With spit on his face and a burst of weirded-out estranged laughter, he felt the ritualistic energy taking hold. Remembering what his badge said when Kibe handed it over to him, he shouted back, trying to match the same firmness as the behemoth of muscly humanoid, “Harry Sanbi!” It wasn’t a bad attempt, but not even close to Hiromi’s.
e55bb1765c1f.t: Telinga Harry berdenging. Dengan ludah di wajahnya dan ledakan tawa canggung yang aneh, ia merasakan energi ritual itu mencengkeramnya. Teringat apa yang tertulis di lencananya saat Kibe menyerahkannya kepadanya, ia balas berteriak, mencoba menyamai ketegasan yang sama seperti humanoid raksasa berotot itu, “Harry Sanbi!” Bukan usaha yang buruk, tetapi bahkan tidak mendekati milik Hiromi.

e60431b3e747.en: “Eww—” With curled lips, Arukia looked away from Harry, who looked half-dead, and focused on Hiromi’s reddened cheeks. “Did you just kick down the door? Why? What is wrong with you? You could just have turned the knob!”
e60431b3e747.t: “Iiih—” Dengan bibir mengerucut, Arukia membuang muka dari Harry, yang tampak setengah mati, dan berfokus pada pipi Hiromi yang memerah. “Kau barusan menendang pintunya sampai roboh? Kenapa? Apa sih masalahmu? Kau kan bisa memutar gagangnya saja!”

e61db5d0dc04.en: You okay, Harry? Eiri’s voice reverberated deep in Harry’s brain, snapping him out of his drunken daze. “I’m sorry, Eiri—it’s just—” Harry took a deep breath to fight the tightening feeling in his chest. “It’s just—” The words were not coming out. It can’t be her, can it? This feeling that he had drunk a pot of coffee was still there. Looking towards Sora, still just as busy as before, the words in his brain seemed jumbled, impossible to just flat out say in front of her.
e61db5d0dc04.t: Kamu baik-baik saja, Harry? Suara Eiri bergema jauh di dalam otak Harry, menyadarkannya dari linglung mabuknya. “Maaf, Eiri—hanya saja—” Harry menarik napas dalam-dalam untuk melawan perasaan sesak di dadanya. “Hanya saja—” Kata-katanya tidak mau keluar. Tidak mungkin dia, kan? Perasaan seolah ia baru meminum sepoci kopi masih ada. Memandang ke arah Sora, yang masih sama sibuknya seperti tadi, kata-kata di otaknya tampak campur aduk, mustahil diucapkan begitu saja di depannya.

e6ba46501c70.en: “MY BAD! MY BAD! WE’RE ALMOST THERE!” Hiromi’s tensed-up voice sounded like he were trying to defuse a bomb before it exploded.
e6ba46501c70.t: “MAAF! MAAF! KITA HAMPIR SAMPAI!” Suara Hiromi yang tegang terdengar seolah ia sedang mencoba menjinakkan bom sebelum meledak.

e737173b9e06.en: Hiromi touched Harry’s back and pointed his half-drunken jar of lolish-floaters at Itanema, spilling some on the floor. “Just put it on my tab! It’s fine!”
e737173b9e06.t: Hiromi menyentuh punggung Harry dan mengarahkan toples lolish-floater-nya yang tinggal setengah ke Itanema, menumpahkan sebagian ke lantai. “Masukkan saja ke bonku! Tidak apa-apa!”

eade316ef031.en: “What?” Pulling his hand out from underneath the kilt, Hiromi had a leather bag about the size of his hand—luckily, it was his balls bag instead of his ballsack. “How many balls?”
eade316ef031.t: “Apa?” Menarik tangannya keluar dari balik kilt, Hiromi memegang kantong kulit kira-kira seukuran tangannya—untungnya, itu kantong bolanya, bukan kantong pelernya. “Berapa bola?”

eaf21fc618f3.en: Looking at the detailed handiwork of the golden metal, Harry couldn’t stop noticing how pretty but foreign it looked. “So this is what people were talking about costing pearls or amethysts?”
eaf21fc618f3.t: Memandangi pengerjaan detail logam emas itu, Harry tidak bisa berhenti memperhatikan betapa cantik tetapi asingnya benda itu. “Jadi ini yang dibicarakan orang-orang soal harga pearl atau amethyst?”

eb8519c78219.en: A grin appeared on Eiri’s face; she winked towards Harry, then moved her head to Sora and spoke stridently, “What? Do you want to ask Sora to marry you? You need to take her to the Sanbi fountain first, then scream in front of everyone that you love her to soul death.”
eb8519c78219.t: Seringai muncul di wajah Eiri; ia mengedipkan mata kepada Harry, lalu menggerakkan kepalanya ke arah Sora dan berbicara dengan nyaring, “Apa? Kamu mau melamar Sora? Kamu harus membawanya ke air mancur Sanbi dulu, lalu berteriak di depan semua orang bahwa kamu mencintainya sampai kematian jiwa.”

ec7666e50826.en: “Really?” Harry yelled out as the images of the duel with Maiara still lingered in his head, specifically when the people were helping him up and even chanting his name. So they didn’t care about me but instead just wanted the fight to continue? I guess that makes sense.
ec7666e50826.t: “Serius?” Harry berseru sementara bayangan duel dengan Maiara masih membekas di kepalanya, terutama saat orang-orang membantunya berdiri dan bahkan meneriakkan namanya. Jadi mereka tidak peduli padaku tapi cuma ingin pertarungannya berlanjut? Kurasa masuk akal.

ed912343e34d.en: Harry felt this ominous sensation of being mocked, but a more potent force within him made him utter, “She sat on my face—I—”
ed912343e34d.t: Harry merasakan sensasi tidak menyenangkan seperti sedang diejek, tetapi kekuatan yang lebih kuat di dalam dirinya membuatnya berucap, “Dia menduduki wajahku—aku—”

ef8ce0a84e0f.en: “But—but what about the ceiling?” Harry pointed up, then looked up as well. “Oh—” Harry’s crap eyes saw the same blurry white ceiling in Eiri’s office.
ef8ce0a84e0f.t: “Tapi—tapi bagaimana dengan langit-langitnya?” Harry menunjuk ke atas, lalu ikut mendongak. “Oh—” Mata Harry yang payah melihat langit-langit putih buram yang sama di kantor Eiri.

efaa909a9108.en: “Aiight.” Hiromi also stood up, approaching Kaiana with his hands up and belly facing forward. He then lowered his hand to match her height.
efaa909a9108.t: “Oke.” Hiromi juga berdiri, mendekati Kaiana dengan tangan terangkat dan perut menghadap ke depan. Ia lalu menurunkan tangannya untuk menyesuaikan dengan tinggi Kaiana.

f035e57d0202.en: Sora snapped her neck towards Eiri, then towards Harry, apparently only then realizing that he was right there. Her hands covered her quickly reddening face. Her eyes widened so much they were about to fall from their sockets as her body turned into stone—she even seemed to stop breathing because of how tensed up she was. The winga feather in her hand succumbed to the pressure and snapped loudly.
f035e57d0202.t: Sora menoleh cepat ke arah Eiri, lalu ke arah Harry, tampaknya baru menyadari bahwa ia ada di sana. Tangannya menutupi wajahnya yang cepat memerah. Matanya terbelalak begitu lebar sampai hampir jatuh dari rongganya sementara tubuhnya berubah menjadi batu—ia bahkan tampaknya berhenti bernapas karena begitu tegangnya. Bulu winga di tangannya menyerah pada tekanan dan patah dengan bunyi keras.

f076c096ddeb.en: “Hey, aren’t you gonna make a drink for us too?” The Darfaries seemed attentive to Yacamim’s muscular but still feminine body as she kept on walking away towards the exit to the atrium, where the stairs to the second floor, bathrooms, and kitchen door were.
f076c096ddeb.t: “Hei, kau tidak mau membuatkan minuman untuk kami juga?” Darfaries itu tampak memperhatikan tubuh Yacamim yang berotot tapi tetap feminin saat ia terus berjalan pergi menuju pintu keluar ke atrium, tempat tangga ke lantai dua, kamar mandi, dan pintu dapur berada.

f0b3a06e7f79.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 2: three men at a bar, one serving a green drink to a giant with a red-and-green mohawk.
f0b3a06e7f79.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 2: tiga pria di sebuah bar, salah satunya menyajikan minuman hijau kepada raksasa berjambul mohawk merah-hijau.

f20ad7325111.en: “I’m—sorry.” Feeling lightweight, Harry dry heaved a few more times, but only thick spit seemed to come out next. His teary eyes, snotty nose, and puke mixed with saliva dripping down his mouth were not a pleasant sight to behold, but his shivering died down, and with it, the feeling of spinning—perhaps that dark feeling inside him too.
f20ad7325111.t: “Aku—minta maaf.” Merasa ringan, Harry muntah kering beberapa kali lagi, tetapi hanya ludah kental yang tampaknya keluar berikutnya. Matanya yang berlinang, hidungnya yang beringus, dan muntahan bercampur air liur yang menetes dari mulutnya bukan pemandangan yang menyenangkan untuk dilihat, tetapi gigilannya mereda, dan bersamanya, perasaan berputar—mungkin juga perasaan gelap di dalam dirinya.

f2320212bdd2.en: The “guy” with amazing blackish purple hair slapped Hiromi’s hand away, then took a big gulp of “his” beer.
f2320212bdd2.t: “Pria” berambut ungu kehitaman yang luar biasa itu menepis tangan Hiromi, lalu menenggak bir “miliknya” banyak-banyak.

f3b01e80e9c7.en: “What? How?” Eiri’s voice sounded like a verbal two-combo word punch; however, her serious gaze didn’t seem aggressive but instigative for a solid answer.
f3b01e80e9c7.t: “Apa? Bagaimana?” Suara Eiri terdengar seperti kombo pukulan verbal dua kata; namun, tatapannya yang serius tidak tampak agresif melainkan mendesak untuk mendapatkan jawaban yang pasti.

f46004993ca1.en: Kaiana crossed her arms underneath her enormous boobs, making them even more salient. Her silent pouting seemed like a chord was struck. “Fine—he did give me his cut after all. Still, we could have made much more if he didn’t act alone, so it’s his own fault, dammit!”
f46004993ca1.t: Kaiana menyilangkan tangannya di bawah payudaranya yang sangat besar, membuatnya semakin menonjol. Cemberut diamnya tampak seolah sesuatu telah menyentuh hatinya. “Baiklah—toh dia memberikan bagiannya padaku. Tetap saja, kita bisa dapat jauh lebih banyak kalau dia tidak bertindak sendirian, jadi itu salahnya sendiri, sialan!”

f489466282a2.en: Harry propped himself forward to ensure he wouldn’t fall backward by the sheer force and volume of the torrential pungent dark yellow stream coming out of his body that smelled worse than the bar’s back alley—maybe his urethra feeling like it was about rupture overstated the actual amount coming out, but in case like these, facts don’t matter, feelings do. Harry’s eyes drew attention to the bathtub where the dream, or rather, nightmare, or perhaps a past reality, surfaced. He could feel as if the same vicious-grinned girl was still sitting at the bathtub, waiting for him even though she clearly wasn’t there. His breathing became shallow, and his heart began to rise again as he was getting close to finishing peeing. As this chaotic feeling inside him took hold, a sense of urgency struck him. Or perhaps it was the incoming gag that came next. Taking a step back as a cold sweat rushed through his body, Harry propped himself on the nearby sink so tightly that his knuckles turned white. Tinnitus then struck him like a flashbang. With a pained groan, he held back the incoming gag with his dear life. I HATE THIS! His mind was growing tired of whatever the fuck was happening inside him.
f489466282a2.t: Harry mencondongkan tubuh ke depan untuk memastikan ia tidak jatuh ke belakang karena kuatnya dan banyaknya aliran deras berwarna kuning gelap dan berbau menyengat yang keluar dari tubuhnya, yang baunya lebih parah daripada gang belakang sebuah bar—mungkin uretranya yang terasa seperti akan pecah melebih-lebihkan jumlah sebenarnya yang keluar, tetapi dalam kasus seperti ini, fakta tidak penting, perasaanlah yang penting. Mata Harry tertuju ke bak mandi tempat mimpi, atau lebih tepatnya, mimpi buruk, atau mungkin kenyataan masa lalu itu, muncul ke permukaan. Ia bisa merasakan seolah gadis berseringai keji yang sama masih duduk di bak mandi, menunggunya walaupun jelas ia tidak ada di sana. Napasnya menjadi dangkal, dan jantungnya mulai berdebar lagi saat ia hampir selesai kencing. Saat perasaan kacau di dalam dirinya ini mencengkeram, rasa mendesak menghantamnya. Atau mungkin itu rasa mual yang datang berikutnya. Mundur selangkah saat keringat dingin mengalir di sekujur tubuhnya, Harry berpegangan pada wastafel di dekatnya begitu erat sampai buku-buku jarinya memutih. Tinitus lalu menghantamnya seperti granat kejut. Dengan erangan kesakitan, ia menahan rasa mual yang datang dengan sekuat tenaga. AKU BENCI INI! Pikirannya mulai lelah dengan apa pun yang sedang terjadi di dalam dirinya, bangsat.

f5ade27ba9a5.en: Without notice, a fist flew through the air from the “guy” and flattened Hiromi’s noise, sending his body backward, clashing against a table, making beer and food fly everywhere. With a bloody fist, this “guy” kept staring murderously at Hiromi. “I’m Yacamim, you meathead fuckwit. Remember the name next time you try to fuck with me!” Yacamim cleaned away her bloodied fist on her own bluish clothing and then pounded the rest of her beer as if nothing had happened.
f5ade27ba9a5.t: Tanpa peringatan, sebuah kepalan tangan melayang di udara dari si “pria” dan meremukkan hidung Hiromi, membuat tubuhnya terpental ke belakang, menabrak sebuah meja, membuat bir dan makanan berhamburan ke mana-mana. Dengan kepalan tangan berdarah, si “pria” ini terus menatap Hiromi dengan haus darah. “Aku Yacamim, dasar otak otot goblok. Ingat namanya lain kali kau coba macam-macam denganku!” Yacamim menyeka kepalan tangannya yang berdarah di pakaiannya sendiri yang kebiruan lalu menenggak habis sisa birnya seolah tidak terjadi apa-apa.

f628f8f4ad36.en: Black honey—yeah. The memory of Arukia’s tea came to mind. Opening his mouth, Harry began tasting this honey’s molasses-like taste characteristics, plus the crystallized sugar’s grainy texture as it rolled down his tongue. His stomach was on the fence at first, but then it made peace with it. This is not as bad as the stuff Arukia gave me.
f628f8f4ad36.t: Madu hitam—iya. Ingatan tentang teh Arukia muncul di benaknya. Membuka mulutnya, Harry mulai mencicipi karakteristik rasa madu ini yang mirip molase, ditambah tekstur berpasir dari gula yang mengkristal saat bergulir di lidahnya. Perutnya awalnya ragu, tetapi kemudian berdamai dengannya. Ini tidak seburuk yang diberikan Arukia.

f6d411e6ed81.en: “Dang it. Aurora gave you Nari Refresher. Hmmm—I think there’s still a dose left from the one Eori made for you. Let’s go bug Kibe right now!” Eiri chuckled. “Unless you want it for dessert?”
f6d411e6ed81.t: “Sial. Aurora memberimu Nari Refresher. Hmmm—kurasa masih ada satu dosis tersisa dari yang dibuat Eori untukmu. Ayo kita recoki Kibe sekarang juga!” Eiri terkekeh. “Kecuali kamu mau itu untuk hidangan penutup?”

f6d65a8190ac.en: Harry’s voice sounded a bit mixed as embarrassment took over. “Eh—I guess true, sorry—” With a more resolute tone, courage finally came through to face Eiri’s snarkiness. “But I—” He took a deep breath. “I can’t shake off this feeling I’m getting! I don’t know what to do—it feels awful when I remember it.”
f6d65a8190ac.t: Suara Harry terdengar agak campur aduk saat rasa malu mengambil alih. “Eh—kurasa benar juga, maaf—” Dengan nada yang lebih tegas, keberanian akhirnya muncul untuk menghadapi sindiran Eiri. “Tapi aku—” Ia menarik napas dalam-dalam. “Aku tidak bisa menghilangkan perasaan yang kurasakan ini! Aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa—rasanya mengerikan kalau aku mengingatnya.”

f6eacc113c55.en: Shit! I completely forgot about that. Harry was drying his face with a hand towel. “I need to go to Eiri right now!”
f6eacc113c55.t: Sial! Aku benar-benar lupa soal itu. Harry sedang mengeringkan wajahnya dengan handuk tangan. “Aku harus menemui Eiri sekarang juga!”

f797ca1c17dc.en: “Just let it loose a bit—it will all work out!” Hiromi gently said, taking another gulp. His eyes glanced towards Kaiana’s breasts for a sec before looking back at his mug. “You two ready for food?”
f797ca1c17dc.t: “Santai sedikit saja—semuanya akan beres!” kata Hiromi dengan lembut, menenggak lagi. Matanya melirik payudara Kaiana sejenak sebelum kembali memandang gelasnya. “Kalian berdua siap makan?”

f7bfd32646e3.en: “Really? Well, then this will be like a what-if story for ya.” Hiromi sat by Harry, wetting his lips with his coma-inducing jar of booze.
f7bfd32646e3.t: “Serius? Yah, kalau begitu ini akan jadi semacam cerita bagaimana-jika untukmu.” Hiromi duduk di samping Harry, membasahi bibirnya dengan toples minuman kerasnya yang bisa bikin koma.

f95e081a73c5.en: Sounding like a heavy smoker, Harry let out a cough filled with phlegm stuck deep in his lungs, almost choking himself in the process. “—where’s Eiri?” His voice sounded a bit croaky. “king-maid?—”
f95e081a73c5.t: Terdengar seperti perokok berat, Harry terbatuk penuh dahak yang tersangkut jauh di paru-parunya, hampir tersedak dalam prosesnya. “—di mana Eiri?” Suaranya terdengar agak serak. “king-maid?—”

f96dfa8f225d.en: “I’m—” Harry’s smile began to wane, his blurry eyes noticing another familiar face in the room—Sora, the maid that made his heart flutter. Although it didn’t flutter this time, it pounded in his chest in fear. The tinnitus in his ear went off again, sounding as loud as a fire alarm. The awful energy inside him, which presumably was ejected from his mouth not long ago, resurfaced deep inside his bowels. With them, intrusive memories crept back into his mind. He placed his hand on his neck, feeling as if his breath was still being taken away.
f96dfa8f225d.t: “Aku—” Senyum Harry mulai memudar, matanya yang buram memperhatikan wajah familier lain di ruangan itu—Sora, pelayan yang membuat hatinya berdebar-debar. Walaupun kali ini hatinya tidak berdebar-debar, melainkan berdebam di dadanya karena takut. Tinitus di telinganya berbunyi lagi, terdengar sekeras alarm kebakaran. Energi mengerikan di dalam dirinya, yang mungkin sudah dikeluarkan dari mulutnya belum lama ini, muncul kembali jauh di dalam ususnya. Bersamanya, ingatan-ingatan yang mengganggu merayap kembali ke benaknya. Ia meletakkan tangannya di lehernya, merasa seolah napasnya masih direnggut.

f9847605ecea.en: Looking at the bag in Hiromi’s hand, Arukia’s eyes seemed thinkative for a second, but then she looked away. “I’m not touching that! Take that to Eiri yourself.” She sensually walked away, waving her hair around—perhaps trying to tease Harry and Hiromi with her swinging hips to gain upper hand in whatever game she was playing inside her head.
f9847605ecea.t: Memandang kantong di tangan Hiromi, mata Arukia tampak menimbang-nimbang sejenak, tetapi lalu ia membuang muka. “Aku tidak mau menyentuh itu! Bawa sendiri ke Eiri.” Ia berjalan pergi dengan sensual, mengibas-ngibaskan rambutnya—mungkin mencoba menggoda Harry dan Hiromi dengan pinggulnya yang bergoyang untuk mendapatkan keunggulan dalam permainan apa pun yang sedang ia mainkan di dalam kepalanya.

f994106dff7f.en: No response came back from Itanema.

fa0f214723dc.en: Narrowing her face, Eiri nodded soon after. “I think I—yeah. Yeah. I remember it—hard stuff injected but no longer active! Yep! That was it—it was solid proof that your corpse came from the Sanbi slums in some shape or another. Sora wouldn’t lie about what she sensed.”
fa0f214723dc.t: Menyipitkan wajahnya, Eiri mengangguk tak lama kemudian. “Kurasa aku—iya. Iya. Aku ingat—zat berat yang disuntikkan tapi tidak lagi aktif! Yap! Itu dia—itu bukti kuat bahwa mayatmu berasal dari permukiman kumuh Sanbi dengan satu atau lain cara. Sora tidak akan berbohong soal apa yang ia rasakan.”

fd2956e96eb0.en: Harry forcibly laughed as he felt the small leftovers of his once enormous love handles being squished. He tried to defend them against Eiri’s pinches, but her pinching abilities were far too masterful.
fd2956e96eb0.t: Harry tertawa dipaksakan saat merasakan sisa-sisa kecil lemak pinggangnya yang dulu sangat besar diremas. Ia mencoba melindunginya dari cubitan Eiri, tetapi kemampuan mencubit Eiri terlalu ahli.

fe021ee8d753.en: “This girl injected something on me—on my neck. I remember it paralyzing me, making my mind murky. I can’t say for sure exactly when, but I think it happened on my first night here.” He closed his eyes, trying to relive it. Inside him, he could feel the anxiety rising. “The ceiling! The ceiling was the same ceiling as my bedroom, but it was nighttime. The—the girl suffocated me—”
fe021ee8d753.t: “Seorang gadis menyuntikkan sesuatu padaku—di leherku. Aku ingat itu melumpuhkanku, membuat pikiranku keruh. Aku tidak bisa memastikan persisnya kapan, tapi kurasa itu terjadi di malam pertamaku di sini.” Ia memejamkan matanya, mencoba mengalaminya kembali. Di dalam dirinya, ia bisa merasakan kecemasan naik. “Langit-langitnya! Langit-langitnya sama dengan langit-langit kamar tidurku, tapi waktu itu malam hari. Gadis—gadis itu mencekikku—”

fe35e5fbbce8.en: “HIROMI GANDEW TOUGH-HAMMER!” The voice reverberated through the parlor with such intensity that the window shook. “Now, say your name.”
fe35e5fbbce8.t: “HIROMI GANDEW TOUGH-HAMMER!” Suara itu bergema di ruang duduk dengan intensitas sebegitu kuat sampai jendela bergetar. “Sekarang, sebutkan namamu.”

feb88db5bef3.en: Harry kept on standing there, with an estranged smile and wrinkled eyes forming as the thought of being turned down again was added to the pot of emotions. Lots of words flew through his mind, but he still just couldn’t develop a sentence.
feb88db5bef3.t: Harry terus berdiri di sana, dengan senyum canggung dan kerutan di sekitar matanya yang terbentuk saat pikiran akan ditolak lagi ditambahkan ke dalam campuran emosinya. Banyak kata melayang di benaknya, tetapi ia masih tidak bisa menyusun satu kalimat pun.
